### From A mixture of exponentials over a rate or inverse temperature has a power-law tail exactly when the mixing distribution has power-law weight at zero rate; a lognormal mixing density gives a tail falling faster than any power and slower than any exponential, and one bounded away from zero keeps an exponential tail

  - [CLAIM-795](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-795.md) — Power laws arise from many mechanisms with no positive feedback: a branching process balanced between extinction and growth, a tuned critical point, first-passage times of a random walk, a mixture of exponential rates, sample-space reduction, steady growth with a spread of ages, and an inverse power of a uniform variable *(Proposed)* — through [ARG-175](../record/arguments.d/ARG-175.md)

  - [CLAIM-806](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-806.md) — Linear preferential attachment is itself balanced at a boundary, between the stretched-exponential tails of weaker attachment and the condensation of stronger, so rich-get-richer processes and criticality are not opposite routes to a power law: both reach one at a marginal point, and differ in what is balanced *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-830

### From An optimal learning policy is a well-defined scalar optimum when four conditions hold: a declared law for the tasks the learner meets given its history and what it has learned; one valuation over outcomes, the same for every policy compared, with resource costs on its scale; a finite value for every policy, from a finite horizon or a discount that outruns the growth of what learning makes attainable; and a policy class over which the best value is attained.   - [CLAIM-1130](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1130.md) — When each period of learning multiplies what every later period can earn by more than discounting shrinks it, no learning policy is optimal: investing one period more always beats stopping, and never stopping earns nothing; so a scalar optimum of learning needs the horizon or the discount to bound the growth of learnability, and declaring a task distribution, costs, a horizon and a valuation does not by itself supply one *(Proposed)* — through [ARG-227](../record/arguments.d/ARG-227.md)

      - [CLAIM-425](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-425.md) — A perspective governs itself with respect to social judgement to the extent that it keeps access to others' judgements of it while making their authority over its conduct depend on their grounds, not on their visibility, repetition or attributed plurality; neither absorbing every judgement nor resisting every one meets this, since both let the judgements set the terms of response *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-415
      - [CLAIM-446](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-446.md) — Some persistent anxiety may be governance-maintained rather than belief-maintained: anticipated threat grants defensive processes authority over action, attention and evidence acquisition; under the avoidance that authority selects, the hypotheses that the situation is dangerous and that it is safe predict the same observation, so repeated safety need not correct the threat estimate; relief reinforces the defense without being evidence of danger; and the regime can outlast a corrected belief, its pathology, where present, being defensive authority insensitive to corrective evidence at avoidable cost *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-283, CLAIM-443
        - [CLAIM-445](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-445.md) — A protective regime, in a person, an institution or a system of states, becomes self-maintaining when the interventions it authorizes shift the evidence used to judge its necessity, the authority and resources of those who judge it, the capacities of its constituents or the threat environment itself in ways that favour its continuation; this can happen when the original threat was real and the first protection apt, and it is a failure only where the regime has become less responsive to evidence that it is no longer needed *(Proposed)*
          - [CLAIM-624](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-624.md) — The wrong beyond violation that an organization commits by reproducing representations and allocations of authority that keep a justified standard from constraining it is a breach of a second-order duty of answerability: to maintain feasible means for relevant violations to become knowable, contestable and correctable; it is a verdict only given an independently justified standard and a feasible alternative *(Proposed)* — through [ARG-064](../record/arguments.d/ARG-064.md) — also rests on CLAIM-348, CLAIM-462, CLAIM-523, CLAIM-614; also argued from CLAIM-520, CLAIM-523, CLAIM-535, CLAIM-727
            - [CLAIM-876](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-876.md) — The organization whose reproduction of occluding representations and allocations of authority breaches the second-order duty of answerability is a relational arrangement, the ground and object of the verdict and not its bearer; the duty falls on the agents or roles that control that reproduction, inside the arrangement or outside it, each as far as its control reaches, so that where no one controls it the duty is breached by no one *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-418, CLAIM-727
            - [CLAIM-877](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-877.md) — The organization that breaches the second-order duty of answerability is a collective institution that is an agent under a stated criterion, and the duty is its own: its obligations, capabilities and reasonable alternatives are the ones the verdict weighs, and those who control its arrangements bear the duty only derivatively, as its officers, so that an arrangement no such institution governs falls outside the claim *(Proposed)*
          - [CLAIM-726](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-726.md) — A party can arrange the conditions under which another commits a real wrong and then use the true accusation, before an audience whose judgement it anticipated, to justify further control over them; the truth of the accusation neither vindicates the party that arranged it nor excuses the one who did wrong *(Proposed)*
      - [CLAIM-715](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-715.md) — Friction that makes the people in a process think before accepting an output differs from friction that makes the institution answerable to their objections, so a system can make individuals think harder while leaving the institution's authority untouched, and the added scrutiny can then serve as evidence that the individuals owned decisions whose conditions they could not change *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-707
    - [CLAIM-352](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-352.md) — Sen's two aspects of freedom divide along the record's line between what an agent can viably reach and the organization that selects among it: viable reachability can stand for the opportunity aspect only through a map from trajectories to valued functionings, which control theory does not supply, and will-organization gives a causal account of part of the process aspect, not of its fairness or legitimacy *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-079
      - [CLAIM-675](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-675.md) — Two forms of support that give a party the same capabilities now can leave it different capabilities later: where capacity is learned by doing and decays with disuse, support that does the work shrinks what the party can reach unaided while support that covers only its shortfall does not, so support, or a technology, cannot be ranked by present capability sets and has to be assessed by the capability trajectory it produces *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-605
        - [CLAIM-754](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-754.md) — A learner's acquired organization fixes three resource-indexed frontiers that move separately: the operational (what it can reliably do now within an operating budget), the developmental (what it can come to do reliably within a further acquisition budget, given a declared interface for what it may learn from) and the inquiry frontier (what it can formulate and pursue); so no scalar measure of competence or plasticity ranks learners or learning processes independently of context, though one can once a task distribution, resource costs, horizon and evaluative preferences are declared *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-475, CLAIM-569, CLAIM-697; also argued from CLAIM-1013, CLAIM-1043
          - [CLAIM-1059](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1059.md) — Understanding in a learning system is the developmental value of its acquired organization, what it makes cheap to learn next, so a frozen exact rule knows every value of its function without understanding it, and understanding entails greater future learnability *(Proposed)*
        - [CLAIM-758](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-758.md) — Overconsolidation, a generalization of overfitting: relative to a declared family of later acquisitions lying outside the training task distribution, continued stabilization of a learner can keep improving its present objective while raising the budget it needs to acquire that family to a declared reliability with its held capabilities kept above a declared floor, so collateral forgetting counts as part of the cost; it is not overfitting to a data distribution, nor task-level overfitting within a training task distribution, and it is a failure only relative to that family and horizon *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-569
          - [CLAIM-1104](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1104.md) — Identity stabilization and adaptability are not two ends of one scale: constraints that conserve selected relations across time make coordinated response possible and can make alternatives slow or costly to reach, so a constraint's adequacy depends on the timescales of the demands it governs and on how fast it can be revised, and adaptive governance maintains a hierarchy of revisable constraints whose response times suit their demands, conserving selectively what enables later transformation *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-025, CLAIM-478
            - [CLAIM-1066](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1066.md) — An organization's identity can be carried by slow collective degrees of freedom that constrain faster activity, while its adaptability requires those slow degrees of freedom to stay selectively controllable and the means of controlling them to stay viable, so the appropriate stabilization is indexed to the timescales of the demands it must answer, and governance maintains a fit between the spectrum of its modes and the temporal structure of those demands *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-1192, CLAIM-331
              - [CLAIM-1070](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1070.md) — The governance of an adaptive organization is partly the governance of its temporal response structure, the rates at which it detects, absorbs, resists, corrects, learns from and reorganizes in response to different classes of demand: identity stabilization makes selected relations persistent across faster fluctuations, adaptive capacity keeps effective control over those relations, including their persistence and coupling, and an appropriate architecture preserves the capacity to reshape that spectrum without losing the conditions for viable organization *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-099
            - [CLAIM-1135](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1135.md) — Identity stabilization and adaptability are different achievements of one temporally organized system, not two competing quantities: an organization keeps identity by selectively conserving some relations while allowing or producing change in others, it can restore its organization fast while transforming slowly within it, what it conserves may be a configuration or the generative continuity by which it revises its configurations, and some of its most important identity-bearing structures may be those that keep its other identity-bearing structures revisable *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-099, CLAIM-916
              - [CLAIM-1061](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1061.md) — The tension between identity stabilization and adaptability has the shape of the paradox of wu-wei, that one cannot try to be effortless, and the two classical routes to wu-wei correspond to its two halves: cultivation, which stabilizes slow structure until fast right response costs nothing, and unlearning, which sheds consolidated structure to keep response open; each route's characteristic failure is the risk the other names, rigid ritual for the first and the loss of the structure that made response cheap for the second *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-541
          - [CLAIM-757](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-757.md) — Whether relief from overconsolidation has a deadline depends on how the capacity to acquire is lost: if it is sustained by use and decays with disuse (the conditions of the owner-endorsed model of learning by doing), renewed varied practice restores it before a threshold point in training and not after; if it is used up by training, as in plasticity loss under continued varied practice, renewed practice does not restore it at any point, and only an intervention that renews what was used up, such as reinitializing units, does, at any point; the evidence read so far fits the second *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-605
      - [CLAIM-681](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-681.md) — How much of a person's time is taken by activities they cannot reasonably refuse limits what they can viably pursue apart from their income and rights, so that two people with the same resources can differ in substantive freedom by their time, and productivity gains taken wholly as output can leave that freedom unchanged or smaller; the contrast that matters is between time committed to demanding activity and time surrendered to necessity, not between work and leisure *(Proposed)*
    - [CLAIM-353](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-353.md) — A will-organization that gives two operators decisive jurisdiction over a pair of options each, respects unanimous preference and admits any profile of operator rankings cannot always choose, and unlike Arrow's impossibility this is not escaped by giving the grant procedure richer, cardinal or comparable, information, so what distributed governance must give up is jurisdiction, unanimity or the domain, not an informational restriction *(Active)*
    - [CLAIM-368](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-368.md) — The primitive for an organization's regulatory difficulty is frustration, not distress: a relation between maintained, consequential demands and the incompatibilities, constraints or countervailing processes that limit their realization, independent of strain, the burden of sustaining activity, and distinct from distress, a possible integrated response to either *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-283
      - [CLAIM-347](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-347.md) — Frustration among an organization's demands is an ordinal fact before it is a quantity: the jointly satisfiable sets of demands form a downward-closed complex whose minimal non-faces are the minimal conflicts, relief is strict enlargement of that complex for the same declared demands, reorganizations that relieve different conflicts are incomparable, and dropping or suppressing a demand is not relief *(Active)*
        - [CLAIM-1193](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1193.md) — Possibility and realization are separate dimensions of a regulatory regime: its compatibility complex says which sets of public demands some attainable history meets, the probability of meeting them under a model of participants' behaviour says how reliably the regime selects such a history, and a regime can improve either without the other *(Active)*
          - [CLAIM-1108](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1108.md) — There is no optimal regulation until the demand specification, the instruments, the horizon and the trade-offs among demands are declared, and a regime is better judged by a profile of possibility, realization, resilience, accountability and cost than by a scalar, so steering an industrial ecosystem optimally is relative to commitments the mathematics does not select *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-347
        - [CLAIM-361](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-361.md) — Relief of an organization's frustration must be judged for an identified organization against a fixed reference set of its original demands, under an explicit correspondence between earlier and later demands: a demand excised or suppressed has changed the comparison and has not been satisfied, an endogenous revision of what the organization maintains is a transformation of it and not relief, and learning can change which processes bear the demands *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-284, CLAIM-287
          - [CLAIM-1121](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1121.md) — A regulation that only adds hard constraints to a fixed dynamical model can only shrink the compatibility complex of the public demands, so it cannot relieve their frustration; a regulation relieves frustration among the original demands only by changing the dynamics, through the technologies, infrastructure or access it brings about *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-347, CLAIM-582
            - [CLAIM-1084](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1084.md) — When demands are predicates on histories with deadlines, the sets of them an organization can jointly meet under its response architecture and budget form a downward-closed complex contained in the complex of the same demands without deadlines, so two demands can be compatible statically and incompatible in time, and a change in the response architecture, faster actuation, different sequencing, staged capacity or a new method, can enlarge the temporal complex without weakening any demand *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-347
              - [CLAIM-1025](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1025.md) — The questions an organization can both pose and answer by a deadline lie between an inner bound, those whose posing and answering fit the horizon and budget run one after the other, and an outer bound, those each of whose processes fits alone, and where between them depends on precedence and sharing that neither frontier records, so two organizations with the same query and answer frontiers can differ in what they can jointly do *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-1114, CLAIM-1157
            - [CLAIM-1173](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1173.md) — Regulation governs possibility: it shapes which actions, relationships, capabilities and forms of coexistence are admissible, attainable, sustainable and revisable, so it is generative when it makes forms of organization attainable that were not, stabilizing when it keeps valuable capabilities through disturbance, and reflexive when its own specifications stay correctable, and there is no choice between governed and ungoverned possibility, only between organizations of it *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-1193, CLAIM-410
          - [CLAIM-1240](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1240.md) — Taking each party's reading of an ambiguous expression as a demand on their joint outcomes, clarifying a consequential misunderstanding relieves frustration by a new distinction only where the readings' demands bear on different situations the expression conflated; where they demand different joint outcomes in the same situation, no distinction relieves them, only an outcome that meets both, and settling on one reading or rewording the demands is not relief *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-1298, CLAIM-347, CLAIM-532
          - [CLAIM-549](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-549.md) — The quiescent complex, the sets of perspectives that some attainable arrangement keeps below their activation thresholds, is not the compatibility complex of their requirements: either can hold a face the other lacks, since a perspective can be quiet while its requirement is unmet and active while it is met; raising thresholds can only enlarge the quiescent complex and leaves the requirement complex as it was, so it is not relief of frustration *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-347
            - [CLAIM-631](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-631.md) — Structural frustration of a set of demands forces, under every attainable arrangement, some member whose demand is unmet while it acts toward it, the precondition of operative thwarting, exactly when no attainable arrangement leaves each member either met or quiet; lying outside both the requirement complex and the quiescent complex does not suffice, the requirement complex is the test when every member acts whenever its demand is unmet, and in a minimal such conflict each member is the unmet, acting one under some arrangement and none is under all *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-347
            - [CLAIM-700](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-700.md) — Where members' conscientious compensation covers an organization's shortfall and the organization budgets to what it observes, the compensation and the quiet it buys are read as adequacy, resources are cut toward what the present configuration needs, and the reconfigurations that would remove the shortfall pass out of reach while the present arrangement stays feasible; and where revealing spare capacity invites its removal, the members' own best responses feed the loop *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-679, CLAIM-702, CLAIM-713
              - [CLAIM-1331](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1331.md) — Pathologies of organized agency need not be failures of achievement: reliable provision, cooperation that works and optimization that meets its objective can each produce them, through eroded fallbacks, captured regulatory work and standing excluded from what is optimized, so in these mechanisms the pathology can deepen while ordinary performance holds or improves, and restoring performance does not reach it *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-060, CLAIM-1054, CLAIM-1244, CLAIM-1252, CLAIM-1256, CLAIM-1287, CLAIM-670
            - [CLAIM-923](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-923.md) — With operative thwarting identified by silencing a process, structural frustration and thwarting are independent in both directions: under a resolution that seeks joint satisfaction a member is thwarted only where the demands in force are jointly unsatisfiable, and in a minimal conflict exactly one member goes unmet while every other member is separately a but-for cause of it; a pair that conflicts minimally need not thwart each other inside a larger organization; thwarting where joint satisfaction is attainable needs a resolution that weighs authority or preference beyond the demands; and a frustrated set can leave an unmet member acting with no process responsible *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-347
          - [CLAIM-554](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-554.md) — Niche differentiation matters to an organization's development as possible relief of structural frustration among its constituents' persistence demands, a strict enlargement of their compatibility complex over viable histories for the same demands, and not as reduced competition: competition, contested rankings, structural and governance frustration, operative thwarting, strain and coexistence come apart, so lower competitive intensity, the exclusion of a constituent or a redistribution of influence relieves no structural frustration of the original demands, and specialization can relieve frustration where nothing competes *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-347, CLAIM-369
            - [CLAIM-1038](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1038.md) — Diversity indicates an ecosystem's richness because differentiated constituents that persist preserve partially independent routes through its possibility space, including questions not yet asked and responses not yet demanded, so diversity of consequential capabilities, not the number of constituents, tracks richness, and it is a generally informative proxy rather than a quantity that always rises with richness *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-463, CLAIM-675, CLAIM-754; also argued from CLAIM-1042
              - [CLAIM-1106](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1106.md) — Intelligence may be understood as the adaptive organization of epistemic ecological richness: richness is what an ecology of differentiated perspectives makes available or can develop, intelligence is the capacity to mobilize, coordinate, evaluate and expand it under resource-bounded demands, so diversity contributes to intelligence without being a synonym for it, and two systems equally competent today can be unequally intelligent for the demands they may meet tomorrow *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-754
          - [CLAIM-743](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-743.md) — A demand owed to a party can cease to apply legitimately only by the exercise of a valid normative power over it, the holder's release or waiver or an authorized revision, which changes the reference set against which relief is judged; an institution's ceasing to count it changes only the set it recognizes, so what separates a valid release from suppression is whether a valid power was exercised, and by whom *(Proposed)*
          - [CLAIM-788](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-788.md) — First Contact's interface learning is learning occasioned by an obstruction whose product is a new channel: the interface cannot know the user's task, a failure of information, and it repairs that not by acquiring the information but by forming a channel through which the party who has it, the user, can steer; command-to-outcome mutual information measures that channel without passing through the task, and maximizing it pursues the record's new channel, a maintained capacity, directly *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-532
            - [CLAIM-787](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-787.md) — First Contact's one failure is a choice of level: a shared-autonomy assistant, from a prior study, that stabilizes the lander overrides the user's commands, damping their influence over the next state while raising it over the episode, so command-to-outcome information depends on the horizon it is taken at, and the horizon the method needs is the level of a rate hierarchy at which the user's goals live; the task knowledge it assumes away is knowledge of that level *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-361, CLAIM-478, CLAIM-761
        - [CLAIM-440](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-440.md) — An organization's appraisal is the negotiation among its perspectives, a common currency is that negotiation's admitting an ordering of the options it faces, and goal-conduciveness valence is a regime in which an ordering of the organization's own states by their bearing on its maintenance prevails in the negotiation; so valence presupposes contested rankings, not frustrated demands, its sign is whether the organization runs ahead of or behind a reference course along the potential ordering, its intensity is how far the negotiation's decisions follow that ordering, and ambivalence, where no ordering prevails, differs from neutrality, where one prevails and the organization keeps to its course *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-039, CLAIM-283
          - [CLAIM-435](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-435.md) — Veit's common currency and ALARM's override are two regimes of one ordering serving as the negotiation's potential, compensatory and overriding, so their rivalry over what the first felt valence did becomes the question whether the earliest potential orderings are continuous: in motivational trade-off experiments, a continuous indifference curve between a noxious cost and a resource for Veit, a discontinuity at a threshold beyond which no resource buys the cost for ALARM; only a graded override, deciding at every level of its own intensity, lacks a currency altogether *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-436
          - [CLAIM-437](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-437.md) — 'Wanting' and 'liking' are saliences relative to different, overlapping processes, pursuit and consummation, each ranking states by their bearing on its own concerns; valence is then relative to a perspective, every perspective in the negotiation has its own, the system's valence is that of the perspective whose ordering is the negotiation's potential, and ambivalence is strong saliences of opposite sign with no potential absorbing them *(Proposed)*
            - [CLAIM-442](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-442.md) — Frijda's emotion and the potential account's system valence sit on opposite sides of the gap between the precedence a motive claims and the authority it is granted: an emotion, action readiness claiming control precedence, is a claim, a perspective's valence is read on its claims, and the system's valence is read on what the negotiation grants, so a change in grants with the claims fixed, as mindfulness is said to make, changes the system's valence and leaves the perspectives' emotions and valences as they were *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-283
            - [CLAIM-447](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-447.md) — Model-based wanting is a pursuit process's ranking of the futures it predicts under candidate interventions, P(S | do(a)) against P(S | do(a₀)), while cue-triggered wanting is learned salience that need not compute those futures; a process's causal model, its wanting and its practical efficacy are separable, so learning to want differently, learning that a want will not pay, and learning not to act on it are three different changes *(Proposed)*
          - [CLAIM-439](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-439.md) — A regime of valence is felt, in the sense of attended and available to the system's other processes, when the system that is in it also models it: when a deeper process infers which ordering wins its negotiation, which way the system is moving along it and how strongly it prevails, and the inference is used elsewhere in the system; unfelt valence is the potential without that model, as unfelt fluency is a change in precision without the inference about it *(Proposed)*
          - [CLAIM-527](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-527.md) — Viable reach, valence and emotion are three quantities in an organization, not one: an emotion is a claim to precedence, system valence is movement along the ordering that wins the negotiation, and a change in what the organization can viably reach is neither, so an organization can run ahead along its prevailing ordering while its viable reach contracts *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-079
          - [CLAIM-897](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-897.md) — The evaluative space model's positivity and negativity channels are perspectives in the thin sense goal-conduciveness valence uses: each ranks the options by its own activation, the two rankings contest exactly the approach–avoidance pairs, and each holds an authority over action apart from its activation, in its gain, its offset and the override of higher levels; so the model's neutral point, both channels low, is no contest, where valence is undefined, not neutrality, and its coactivation is contest, which a record of conduct shows as ambivalence only when no candidate ordering, a stable compromise included, accounts for the decisions *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-283
          - [CLAIM-899](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-899.md) — A record of conduct returns, for each window, one of six verdicts, no contest, too few contests, indeterminate, prevails, split by context or ambivalent, and across windows persistence, resumption and alternation, when contest is read from the perspectives' rankings measured apart from the decisions, alignment is scored for each candidate ordering including a compromise, ambivalence is a misfit to every candidate larger than the record's own departures on uncontested decisions would produce, and prevalence is a lead over every rival that survives resampling; it measures actual potential, the conflicts won, not dispositional potential *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-434
        - [CLAIM-532](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-532.md) — An unresolved discrepancy is an occasion for self-formation, the transformation dimension of a will-organization, and not a guarantee of it; it suffices for self-formation that the agent's own activity on such a discrepancy produce a maintained capacity, either a new distinction, its policy coming to depend on a feature of its situation it did not depend on, or a new channel, the outcomes it can reach under its own policy growing, that outlasts the discrepancy and serves a class of later ones, as shown by transfer to discrepancies of the same class after the inducing conditions are gone and by interventions on the processes that produce the capacity while it forms *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-025, CLAIM-522, CLAIM-535, CLAIM-540; also argued from CLAIM-535
          - [CLAIM-1175](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1175.md) — A self is a historically developing organization of overlapping dispositions and perspectival relations whose observable differentiation depends on the available tests, but whose unity, if it has one, must be established through the causal processes that coordinate, maintain and transform those dispositions; its perspectives need not be independently individuated constituents and can admit several equally adequate factorizations, and the self can acquire new distinctions and channels through their interaction, changing the structure in which later perspectives become possible *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-284, CLAIM-574
            - [CLAIM-1168](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1168.md) — Slow collective variables that govern an ecosystem divide into common drivers its members read and condition on but do not regenerate, such as tides, day and night, lunar cycles, seasons and imposed human cadences, which entrain them without integrating them, and variables their interactions regenerate, such as predator–prey oscillations, which meet the criterion of a constitutive collective variable, so the structural answer as worded is defeated by the second kind *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-1172, CLAIM-165, CLAIM-327
              - [CLAIM-1126](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1126.md) — What marks a plurality of pseudo-selves as integrated, rather than an ecosystem, is not a regenerated whole-level slow variable but one its members address as the whole's own, acting on it as theirs, as a firm's culture or a sector's standard is held; a predator–prey cycle, regenerated but addressed by no member as the community's, leaves an ecosystem an ecosystem *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-327
                - [CLAIM-1045](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1045.md) — Migration is an endogenous slow collective variable that presses harder than a predator–prey cycle: a route is followed by members as the group's route and regenerated by being followed, and where it is learned socially it is held as the group's own, so it may meet even the narrowed criterion of a variable members address as the whole's, leaving no difference in kind between an integrated plurality and an ecosystem of migrants *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-1172, CLAIM-327
          - [CLAIM-1228](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1228.md) — Inquiry, representation, legibility, governance and learning form a loop: inquiry yields what is to be represented, representation fixes what can be identified and attributed, legibility which differences can inform decisions, governance who can revise claims and standards, and learning the maintained capacities that feed back into the next inquiry's questions, representations and standards *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-469, CLAIM-470, CLAIM-523, CLAIM-535
          - [CLAIM-1229](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1229.md) — What scholarly evaluation should recognize is contribution to a community's maintained capacity for inquiry and not the maintenance of a body of knowledge as such: a record can grow while the community's capacities stay the same, so rewarding maintenance without that test rewards accumulation *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-1223, CLAIM-475
          - [CLAIM-1236](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1236.md) — A capacity for reflexive self-governance can itself be seeded by a transmissible expression: taking up a representation of how one's dependence on others' attributions or influence works can help form, through one's own activity, a capacity to examine and revise that dependence; but holding the representation, or believing oneself autonomous, is not having the capacity, which shows only in effective revisions of dependencies met after the exposure *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-1218, CLAIM-424, CLAIM-545
        - [CLAIM-534](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-534.md) — A plural will's motivational integration, a dimension of freedom of will the record names and leaves unanalysed, is the extent to which the demands it maintains are jointly met, within tolerances it can recognize, across the contexts where they interact, and kept so under its own dynamics; it is neither agreement among the demands nor the dominance of one, and its parts come apart: realizability (the tolerance frontier), realization (governance frustration), maintenance (viability) and the allocation of the tolerance each demand gives up *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-079, CLAIM-357, CLAIM-538
          - [CLAIM-552](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-552.md) — A perspective's tolerance for another process's contribution is its criterion for conferring influence on that contribution, set by its own priorities: tolerances are directed, and the discrepancy each measures is the perspective's own, so inside its tolerance the perspective's interventions raise the other's share of future influence and outside it they lower it; meeting the tolerance is necessary for that conferral where the criterion binds, and sufficient only for a grant, under a rule that grants influence on it *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-347
          - [CLAIM-553](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-553.md) — Give each of an individual's perspectives a scalar intervention threshold on its discrepancy from the will it wants effective: the intervention that can be observed is the propensity to mobilize times the chance that the discrepancy is legible and a channel carries the intervention, so a perspective that does not intervene has not thereby endorsed; and read through Frankfurt, wholeheartedness is the will that moves the individual to act lying within every perspective's tolerance, a full face of the requirement complex and not of the quiet one, so a structurally frustrated individual cannot act wholeheartedly unless its demands change *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-347, CLAIM-417
        - [CLAIM-550](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-550.md) — A perspective's tolerance of departure from what it maintains can be derived from its activation threshold: if its activation is z = b(c) + α(c)d, rising with discrepancy d (α > 0), and it acts with probability σ(κ(z − θ)), the discrepancy it tolerates while acting with probability at most ε is (θ + κ⁻¹ logit ε − b(c))/α(c); so one fixed threshold gives different tolerances across contexts through baseline and gain, a negative tolerance marks activation driven by something other than the discrepancy, and raising a threshold enlarges tolerance without relieving any demand *(Active)*
          - [CLAIM-551](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-551.md) — Read in DBT's sense, cognitive dysregulation is a consequence of emotion dysregulation, not a failure to allocate attention: a perspective with high gain, intense response and slow return to baseline has a small and lingering tolerance, can stay active when the current discrepancy no longer warrants it, and while active supplies the interpretation that governance acts on, so the effective will becomes mood-dependent; it predicts impairment that follows arousal and its slow decay, where the attentional reading predicts impairment that follows competing demand on a fixed budget *(Active)*
        - [CLAIM-555](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-555.md) — In statistical learning, the compatibility complex of the demands a training distribution presents and the singular geometry singular learning theory studies are two invariants of one object, not descriptions of two: each demand's acceptance set is a sublevel set of its loss on the parameter space, the complex is the nerve of those sets, and the aggregate loss whose geometry fixes the learning coefficient is built from the same losses; the nerve is coarse, the learning coefficient finer, and over a fixed architecture the complex changes in training only through which configurations are accessible *(Proposed)*
        - [CLAIM-583](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-583.md) — Two constraint systems can have the same compatibility complex, the same move rule and the same costs and differ in whether a configuration meeting one demand reaches one meeting another, so compatibility equivalence does not imply equivalence of reachability *(Active)*
          - [CLAIM-576](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-576.md) — What characterizes a constrained system is a repertoire of realizable processes, indexed by resources and dependent on its architecture, rather than its set or space of states, and the repertoire changes in three ways an equivalence between such systems must keep apart: a budget makes an existing transformation affordable, observational or computational capability makes an existing possibility discoverable or controllable, and a change of architecture alters which transformations are possible *(Proposed)*
            - [CLAIM-611](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-611.md) — When an organized individual persists through changes of state and mode, in the dynamical and historical senses of persistence, what persists is the particular organization that keeps its repertoire realizable, not the repertoire it keeps, nor any state, mode or boundary; that organization may lie inside the individual or outside it *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-025, CLAIM-079, CLAIM-478, CLAIM-522, CLAIM-566, CLAIM-567, CLAIM-612, CLAIM-625
              - [CLAIM-615](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-615.md) — An organized individual's identity over time is carried by the causal transmission of the relations that keep its repertoire realizable, not by its constituents or by any structure invariant across its realizations, so a structuralism about individuals has to be historical: the structure can change under maps that are not isomorphisms while the individual continues, two structurally identical copies can be two individuals, the transmitting organization may lie outside the individual, and when those relations part at a succession, different successors can continue different respects of it *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-280, CLAIM-287, CLAIM-328, CLAIM-329, CLAIM-593; also argued from CLAIM-593
                - [CLAIM-1165](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1165.md) — A collective identity may be a historically sustained organization of overlapping perspectives whose interactions constitute an evolving question–answer game, residing not in its members, questions, answers or rules but in the maintained organization of the game, including the means by which its own rules are revised, so that it is a slow mode of the game, and a collective that reproduces the capacity to revise is adaptive where one stable by suppressing alternatives is not *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-099, CLAIM-1053, CLAIM-1066
                - [CLAIM-620](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-620.md) — Concepts are individuated over time by the transmission criterion that governs organized individuals, so in reflexive social systems the coupling of meaning and will runs through what is transmitted and can remake the concepts, perspectives and organizations it runs in: meaning-making and individuation condition each other, without that persistence showing truth, consensus or autonomy *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-283, CLAIM-330, CLAIM-336, CLAIM-402, CLAIM-535
              - [CLAIM-986](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-986.md) — In the transmission criterion of identity over time, an outside maintainer's organization is part of what is transmitted just insofar as it holds organization the repertoire depends on that the individual does not carry and that a competent unrelated replacement, working from the individual, would not supply; a garage holds none of a car's, so a change of garage continues the car whole, while an unrelated new maintainer can continue a project only in the respects its code carries *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-328, CLAIM-329; also argued from CLAIM-280, CLAIM-329
        - [CLAIM-586](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-586.md) — Indexing the compatibility complex by a resource budget gives a complex that grows with the budget and never exceeds the complex with no budget, so a set of demands outside the unbudgeted complex is structurally frustrated at every budget, and one inside it but outside the complex at budget b is frustrated only relative to b, short of resources and not structurally frustrated *(Active)*
          - [CLAIM-556](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-556.md) — Before the four obstructions to a transition stands a failure of compatibility, no configuration meeting the demands, repaired by changing the constraints, since dropping a demand is not relief; and after them a failure of regeneration, the capability not surviving turnover, repaired by maintenance or reproduction; so a diagnosis runs through six levels, each with its own repair *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-347, CLAIM-566, CLAIM-568
            - [CLAIM-1198](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1198.md) — What regulation should conserve in an industrial ecosystem is often a capability and the conditions of its reproduction, its infrastructure, expertise and access, and not the organization that now performs it *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-075
          - [CLAIM-560](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-560.md) — The resource-indexed compatibility filtration and the resource-indexed reachability filtration of one architecture both grow with the budget and neither determines the other: a budget can make a transition between configurations already feasible affordable while adding no jointly satisfiable set of demands, and a configuration can be feasible at a budget at which it is unreachable from the start *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-571
            - [CLAIM-1097](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1097.md) — For demands on the configuration held at the horizon, the history complex over horizon H at a capacity budget B is the configuration complex restricted to the configurations reachable from the start within H at B, when holding a configuration is an admissible move and the attainable histories are exactly the move sequences that stay within B; without holding, or with demands met at different times, the two differ *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-347
            - [CLAIM-729](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-729.md) — The duties to comply with a justified rule, to support a justified institution and to help establish a needed one are distinct and none follows from another, and the third is bounded by whether the needed arrangement can be reached from the present one by permissible, resource-bounded transitions and by whose part it is to contribute *(Proposed)*
            - [CLAIM-746](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-746.md) — Four judgments about an authority are distinct: the warrant of the obligations it is to serve, its jurisdiction over the matter, its arrangement's capacity to realize those obligations together, and its capacity to reach compliant arrangements and correct failures by permitted means; neither of the first two follows from any of the others, and of the last two only the dynamic one implies the static one, for what it reaches *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-075, CLAIM-737
        - [CLAIM-588](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-588.md) — Relieving an incompatibility, redistributing an unavoidable mismatch and exploiting a mismatch dynamically are three design targets, which change respectively the compatibility complex, where residuals or loads concentrate, and stability, barriers or transition paths, and the last two can be achieved without the first *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-538
        - [CLAIM-618](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-618.md) — Indexed by a system's control parameters, the compatibility complex of its synchronization demands gives each set of demands a region where they can be met together; an Arnold tongue is a locking region, where a demand is met by an attracting state, and each locking region lies inside the compatibility region of the same demands without needing to equal it *(Proposed)*
        - [CLAIM-634](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-634.md) — For demands that two contexts' local values differ by a preferred real offset within a tolerance, the minimal sets of demands that cannot be met together are exactly the simple cycles of contexts whose holonomy exceeds their summed tolerance: without parallel overlaps every pair of demands is compatible, a minimal conflict can have any length from three to the number of contexts, Helly's bound on its size is attained by a cycle through every context, and in this class a missing face of the compatibility complex is a failed global assignment *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-538
        - [CLAIM-662](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-662.md) — For a fixed arrangement, expanding the recognized demand set cannot improve conjunctive compliance and cannot decrease the count of recognized violations; where governance penalizes newly recognized violations without rewarding their discovery, an organization may acquire an incentive not to improve its identification of its obligations *(Active)*
          - [CLAIM-657](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-657.md) — An organization can become normatively less informed without censoring anyone by two distinct routes, selective disappearance of the harmed from the population it observes and costly discovery that keeps it from investigating the questions that would reveal unmet obligations; neither needs deliberate suppression, and both differ from the counter-corrective weakening of the channels through which challenge succeeds, so that they should not be conflated in attributing responsibility *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-652
      - [CLAIM-357](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-357.md) — The frustration residual and governance regret separate structural infeasibility, realized violation and minimax suboptimality, and identify none of them as thwarting: a positive residual says no admissible update meets every declared requirement, a positive regret only that the actual update's worst residual exceeds the best achievable, which can hold while every requirement is met, and actual violation needs regret above the negative residual; aggregate performance does not tell infeasibility from realized violation, and the multipliers that certify infeasibility need not be the weights governance assigns *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-365
        - [CLAIM-500](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-500.md) — The governance-induced kind of frustration is not idle: some failures of an organization's actual updates to meet demands that an admissible update would meet are explained by how influence is allocated, and not by step size, curvature, noise, conditioning or a fixed weighting rule *(Proposed)*
    - [CLAIM-487](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-487.md) — Describing the relations that decide which regime becomes effective as one will-organization, across realizers, explains something that planning theory, control theory, executive-control research and institutional theory each describing their own realizer does not *(Proposed)*
    - [CLAIM-868](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-868.md) — A manipulation that installs a will-organization within the agent's own reach and then withdraws its channel leaves no feature of will-organization that differs from its unmanipulated twin, because every relation the account names, maintenance and the capacity to transform included, is fixed by the agent's present state, dynamics and couplings; so the more an agent can reach by its own revision, the more manipulation its present can hide, and only a record kept while the organization formed, outside the state a manipulator could set, of which channel carried each governing relation across its threshold, can tell the two apart *(Proposed)*
      - [CLAIM-867](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-867.md) — An alternative: another party's standing channel into an agent is a fact about the agent's situation, not a relation of its will-organization, which is the organization the agent's own processes maintain, so no feature of will-organization differs between a manipulated will and its unmanipulated twin even while the manipulator keeps its channel, and the channel belongs with formation provenance among what a record must contain *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-027
  - [CLAIM-613](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-613.md) — A fork can be the construction of a new organization through which a disposition that the parent's governance kept ineffective gains efficacy, and not only one of several successors of the parent *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-287

    - [CLAIM-518](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-518.md) — Normative judgments about an organization's continuity, reform or obligations can depend on diachronic relations that descriptions of present states or terminal outcomes do not show, so specifying the relevant relations and histories can be necessary to apply them adequately; which continuations ought to follow is a further normative question, not a prerequisite of every normative judgment *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-350

      - [CLAIM-472](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-472.md) — Because an apparatus makes some distinctions determinate and leaves others unstatable, choosing and maintaining one is open to evaluation and not only to verification; but that a cut excludes something fixes no obligation, since every distinction excludes, and which exclusions matter is a judgment indexed to a standard, a scale and those affected *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-363

- [CLAIM-1029](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1029.md) — In a population built on the coupled meaning–influence model, grants indexed by role with the critic role scored by observed relevance leave neither belief factions nor capture, while scalar grants fail one way or the other: scored by agreement they capture the population or split it into factions, and moved by the reward for realized policy they split it into factions that read only their own side; indexing by role without a separate score buys nothing *(Active)*

      - [CLAIM-078](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-078.md) — The theory succeeds if its observational and decision measures predict changes of communicative identity that text similarity misses and follow its compositional predictions across reconstructions; it needs neither quantum contextuality nor exact Noether laws *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-107](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-107.md) — Under Markov reconstruction kernels, an observable's expectation is invariant when the observable is harmonic (K f = f), and drifts by at most Σ ε_i when ‖K_i f − f‖∞ ≤ ε_i; on a finite irreducible chain only constants are harmonic *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-635](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-635.md) — Under Markov reconstruction kernels, an observable conserved exactly at every step and not constant on the support of the starting law keeps information about the start at every generation, bounded below independently of the generation, so such a chain cannot converge to a law independent of its start, while a bounded conservation defect does not prevent forgetting *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-270
    - [CLAIM-779](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-779.md) — In a linear Gaussian restatement step with per-step noise, the information a feature keeps about its start falls geometrically, as a to the power 2n, where the step contracts the feature, and only as 1/n where the step copies it with error: a feature copied with any error drifts slowly instead of settling, and only a feature copied exactly keeps its start *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-270
      - [CLAIM-773](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-773.md) — In a linear Gaussian restatement step, an idea's drift from its source splits by the part of the step each feature lies in: a contracted feature drifts toward the convention and stops there, a feature copied with random error drifts undirected as the square root of the number of steps, a feature copied with a bias drifts directed and without bound, and a conserved one does not drift; a constant bias costs no retention, so drift and retention vary independently; and a feature passes a distance δ after about δ²/σ² restatements by random error, after ln(D/(D − δ))/ln(1/a) by contraction toward a convention at distance D > δ, and by contraction toward a convention nearer than δ only through noise *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-270, CLAIM-635
        - [CLAIM-767](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-767.md) — A residual network's depth is a restatement chain whose skip connection copies the state and whose branches add to it, so the drift kinds of the linear Gaussian model apply: random branch contributions add diffusively and stay of order one under a branch scale of one over the square root of depth, systematic ones add linearly and need one over depth, and a network without skip connections contracts in depth and forgets its input over a depth scale *(Proposed)*
          - [CLAIM-771](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-771.md) — A transformer's depth orders its processing in coarse stages around a broad middle that is robust to intervention but not redundant, refining one prediction while its representation drifts, rather than ascending through levels of knowledge: early layers are distinct and sensitive, middle layers can be skipped, reordered or run in parallel with graceful loss though not replaced by copies of one layer, and an ordering of linguistic information by layer, overlapping in the middle and revised per example from above, is the main evidence against reading depth as refinement alone *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-478
        - [CLAIM-777](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-777.md) — If ideas arrive at rate λ, are coded by one first-come coder at rate κ > λ, and are restated once per unit of time while they wait, an idea's expected drift before it is coded is σ²/(κ − λ) in mean square for features copied with error and (c − x₀)·ln(1/a)/(κ − λ + ln(1/a)) in mean for contracted ones, so drift tracks the ratio of arrival to anchoring hyperbolically and grows without bound as the ratio reaches one; coding at a fixed occurrence caps it at that many restatements' worth *(Proposed)*
          - [CLAIM-782](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-782.md) — Whether slowing an exchange without anchoring anything reduces drift as much as anchoring does turns on whether drift accrues per restatement or per unit of time: if per restatement, an idea never coded drifts through every restatement it gets at any pace, and only anchoring bounds it; if per unit of time, slowing can reduce it, and the rival can hold *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-186, CLAIM-773
        - [CLAIM-783](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-783.md) — If restating an entry adds an error and then enforces its predicates, each a projection onto the closed convex set of versions passing its test, then every version reached lies in the intersection of those sets, the step's fixed points are exactly that intersection, drift from a start inside it is bounded by its diameter, and each added predicate can only shrink it; a predicate enforced softly, by a penalty of strength λ on distance from its set, leaves versions outside by an amount that falls with λ and has the hard predicate as its limit; and a predicate the entry already passes when it is added, an exact descriptor of a dimension left undescribed, moves nothing and leaves that dimension no drift from then on, while one the entry fails moves it, to a convention that keeps nothing of the entry on that dimension or to its source, restoring what had drifted; and predicates the entry passes when added never conflict, since the entry witnesses them *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-635
          - [CLAIM-943](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-943.md) — A descriptor and an imposition are an informative and a performative update: adding a predicate an entry already passes restricts the admissible versions to those where it holds, which is informative update, and enforcing one it fails moves each version to a nearest version where it holds, which is performative update when minimal change is read as nearness in a metric; so the record's two kinds of predicate are the two directions of fit *(Proposed)*
            - [CLAIM-949](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-949.md) — The record's account of specification is model-theoretic, a set of tests and the versions that pass them all, as an institution pairs sentences with the models that satisfy them; type theory is its proof-relevant counterpart, in which a specification is a type, a question a problem, a realization an inhabitant carried with the evidence that it passes, adding a descriptor a refinement the entry provably inhabits, which is why descriptors cannot conflict, and the direction of fit is bidirectional typing's split between inferring a type from a term and checking a term against a type given *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-470, CLAIM-783; also argued from CLAIM-783
    - [CLAIM-789](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-789.md) — In any inquiry whose sources are revised, copying exactly anchors a copy to the version it was taken from, so the copy keeps what a later revision removed: exact copying conserves staleness as faithfully as content, and what anchors a derived text to a revisable source is a tie to the source that a revision has to pass through, not exactness *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-1087](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1087.md) — When a response adapts toward its evaluative standard and the standard adapts toward the response, their gap closes at the sum of the two rates while a weighted mean of the two is conserved, so both converge to a point fixed by their initial conditions and not by any independent target; a pull of the standard toward an independently grounded target makes that target the stable equilibrium *(Proposed)*
  - [CLAIM-1050](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1050.md) — In the anchored model of a response and its co-adapting standard, after a transient the gap between them is a fixed small fraction of the response's distance from the independent target, about the anchoring rate over the sum of the adaptation rates, and that distance closes only at about the response's rate times that fraction, so a weakly anchored standard shows near-perfect measured compliance long before the response is adequate *(Proposed)*
  - [CLAIM-1053](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1053.md) — A regulatory equilibrium may be the stabilization of a mutually reinforcing question–answer relationship rather than the discovery of an independently satisfactory answer: the slow mode of a coupled standard and response belongs to neither alone, so identity stabilization can be read as the reproduction of persistent query–answer relationships, and a response spectrum should sometimes be computed for the combined query–target system *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-1114](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1114.md) — Where a response runs through stages that do not compete for a shared resource, its time is a property of the route, stages in sequence adding their times, stages that overlap contributing the longest of theirs and a stage completed before the contingency contributing nothing, so the slowest component bounds the response time only when it lies on the route and is still to be done *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-112](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-112.md) — The operational account does not say that meaning is nothing but observable behaviour, nor that no stable content exists because interpretation is context-dependent *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-1156](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1156.md) — Two organizations that give the same answers can differ in what answering does to them, so a response kernel that includes the organization's state after answering, observed through its later responses rather than compared as a state, separates what an answer benchmark treats as equivalent, such as one that learns from disagreement and one that suppresses it *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-1169](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1169.md) — The prediction that a corporation changed only by sanction reverts when the sanction lifts, while one whose concerns were redesigned does not, separates remorse from prudence only in the redesigned arm and only with reputation and benefit held fixed: reversion of a sanction-only corporation is predicted by the reading on which every installed concern is prudence as well, and so is persistence of a redesigned one whose procedure still pays *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-1172](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1172.md) — Ecosystems are governed by slow collective variables, such as tides, day and night, lunar cycles, seasons, predator–prey oscillations, boundary effects at interfaces with other ecologies and cadences set by human activity, so having a whole-level slow variable cannot be what separates a pseudo-self from an ecosystem of pseudo-selves *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-1183](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1183.md) — In a simulated sensor network whose correspondences drift, revision improves prediction on positions the network did not choose only when it answers to beacons whose position and channel the revision can neither rewrite nor refuse; revision by the sensors' disagreement alone restores consistency and not accuracy, and a revisable beacon map or a right to refuse disagreeing beacons loses part or all of the gain *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-1194](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1194.md) — Where no process holds evidence on a block of tasks that does not come from the proposals themselves, a governance rule that treats its members alike cannot tell honest dissent from an attack that pushes the same block as hard: in a world and in its relabelling, with the dissenters' and attackers' targets swapped, it ends in the same place, so what it gains for the dissenters in one world it gains for the attacker in the other *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-121](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-121.md) — A transport whose local kernels commute with restriction maps overlap-consistent source models to overlap-consistent target models *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-1216](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1216.md) — An expectation can be structural rather than represented: a process can be organized so that its working presupposes another's behaviour, and the presupposition can be realized in a capacity it has stopped maintaining, so that it no longer needs, or no longer knows how, to do the thing for itself *(Proposed)*
  - [CLAIM-1256](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1256.md) — A provider whose realized reliability exceeds its declared guarantee can lower the resilience of the organization built on it: those who depend on it stop maintaining the fallbacks the guarantee would require, so its rare failures propagate, and holding realized reliability near the declared level keeps their expectations at the guarantee *(Proposed)*
    - [CLAIM-1343](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1343.md) — Institutions can come to rely on another institution's historically reliable restraint beyond what law guarantees and stop maintaining alternatives to it, so that a lawful departure from a convention defeats capacities organized around the expectation, and the risk lies less in the departure than in the alternatives the encompassing organization no longer keeps *(Proposed)* — through [ARG-251](../record/arguments.d/ARG-251.md)
- [CLAIM-1218](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1218.md) — A meme can act as a nucleation site: a seed around which beliefs, practices and relations organize, and not only a unit that copies itself *(Proposed)*
  - [CLAIM-1230](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1230.md) — A meme's virality and its generativity come apart: how often and how faithfully it is copied does not fix how much organization forms around it, so a widely copied meme can organize little and a rarely copied one much *(Proposed)*
  - [CLAIM-1232](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1232.md) — Persistent reproduction of a meme can nucleate related but distinct perspectives: once reproduced apart from the perspective that produced it, a meme is taken up by carriers whose own characters it seeds differently, so its circulation can diversify the perspectives it touches rather than copy one, as in the death of the author *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-1227
  - [CLAIM-1275](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1275.md) — Transmissible cultural structures can take part in the genesis of organizations by enabling relations and processes that would otherwise be less realizable, and the persistence of the seed, of the organization it nucleates and of the perspective it carries are distinct phenomena *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-280, CLAIM-329, CLAIM-420, CLAIM-463
- [CLAIM-1227](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1227.md) — Memes are characteristic values of perspectives: each records how a perspective responds to one kind of transformation of a situation, so a family of memes samples a perspective's character without being it *(Proposed)*
  - [CLAIM-1271](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1271.md) — A meme's agnotological effect is set by its position in an organization of interpretation and authority, not by its propositional content: perspectives that share a meme can differ in characteristic ignorance by applying it selectively, and perspectives with different memes can share one *(Proposed)*
  - [CLAIM-1285](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1285.md) — Memes can express characteristic aspects of a perspective's relational organization independently of its realization and, through uptake, take part in nucleating and reconstituting perspectives in other carriers, so memetic fidelity can be the preservation of characteristic relations rather than the copying of content *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-132, CLAIM-329
    - [CLAIM-1286](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1286.md) — Reproducing an organizational perspective can transmit characteristic limitations on legibility, interpretation, epistemic authority, inquiry and correction without transmitting false propositions, memes can express and help nucleate them in other realizations, and the ignorance can be maintained by endogenous dynamics without a shared intention to suppress knowledge *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-132, CLAIM-523
- [CLAIM-1244](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1244.md) — Cooperation yields a regulatory surplus, the monitoring, verification, contingency planning and conflict resolution that reliance makes unnecessary, and the surplus can be captured asymmetrically: as the relationship comes to rest on the party better at maintaining it, the other can divest its own regulatory capacity while the first keeps bearing the cost, under the same visible harmony as a relationship that shares it *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-1287](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1287.md) — Where the losses that discipline an institution's extraction from those who depend on it, their exit, challenge, regulation and internal resistance, depend on a state its own actions change, an institution optimizing a narrow objective over time values weakening those constraints for their own sake, so their erosion can be produced by the optimization itself, with no change in the character of those who run it *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-1293](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1293.md) — Contracts can form between processes, as service-level agreements do between services, and can operationalize standing: a contract's prioritization structure can govern how disputes between processes, such as races, are resolved *(Proposed)*
  - [CLAIM-1239](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1239.md) — A relation between processes is contract-like only if it governs deviation, conflict or breach and not only the ordinary course: it maintains reciprocal requirements, responds differently to their satisfaction and violation, settles which prevails when they conflict, and is sustained or revised by some mechanism; its formation, which need not be explicit or agreed, nucleates a constraint on the processes' later interaction *(Proposed)*
    - [CLAIM-1264](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1264.md) — A meme can carry a portable specification of a governance or inquiry protocol, a precedence, a threshold or a burden of evidence, which is not a contract but one around which contracts can be organized in each organization that takes it up; so a culture of inquiry can be in part a shared repertoire of such protocols and not only of beliefs *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-1218
    - [CLAIM-1270](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1270.md) — An organization's characteristic structure can include the contracts maintained among its processes, which its ordinary behaviour does not reveal: two arrangements alike on the ordinary course can part when a contract is breached, an assumption fails or a process invokes its standing *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-1293, CLAIM-364
- [CLAIM-1298](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1298.md) — An ambiguity becomes consequential only when a case first gives its readings different consequences, so a misunderstanding dates the distinction's relevance rather than its existence, and clarifying it can coarsen as well as refine: readings found to agree on every case that matters are merged *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-132](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-132.md) — Characters classify finite-dimensional representations of a finite or compact group up to isomorphism only over a field of characteristic zero; they forget the isomorphisms, fix neither the group nor a permutation action, and classify kinds, not tokens or positions *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-1311](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1311.md) — The character of a perspective's representation detects the transformations it is blind to, not the states it merges: its kernel is the observational invariance subgroup when the projection is equivariant and its image spans, but a projection can merge states no transformation relates while its character shows no blindness at all *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-350
- [CLAIM-135](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-135.md) — Recovering latent structure from relational data is three achievements, reconstruction, identification up to stated ambiguities, and constitution of a communicative kind, and identifiability theory reaches the second at most *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-454](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-454.md) — A latent feature or mode recovered from an organization's members' activity is at most a constituent of an organizational perspective, not the perspective: a feature allocation says which members take part in which modes, and whether those modes are organized into one perspective depends on the relations of access, uptake and authority among their carriers, which the same allocation leaves open *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-414
    - [CLAIM-543](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-543.md) — What separates a language model's distribution over personas from a distribution over organizational perspectives is not whether the latent model is hierarchical, since a mixture or an LDA-style admixture already is, but whether some latent components condition which others are available or consequential: a model whose components are exchangeable given their weights is organizationally flat however many levels its prior has, and dependencies among components count as organization (organization as relational arrangement) only where interventions, not fit, support them *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-135, CLAIM-414
- [CLAIM-140](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-140.md) — The October thesis replaces what a receiver can reconstruct with what the analyst's probe system can identify as the test of what survives, and no turn argues the change *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-211](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-211.md) — Read as worded, the manuscript's thesis and the October thesis give rival answers to what survives, which come apart in both directions on the cases of the receiver objection, yet the record links them by `complements` and scopes the October thesis to a question its fidelity clause does not stay inside *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-223](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-223.md) — Whether a distinction survived is fixed by what the receivers can recover, and whether it can be shown to have survived is fixed by what the analyst's probes can identify, so the manuscript's thesis and the October fidelity clause, read so, answer different parts of one question *(Active)*
    - [CLAIM-450](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-450.md) — Three standards for a communicative distinction come apart: statistical distinguishability of an interpreter's response profiles, measured locally by the Fisher metric and never raised by a parameter-independent garbling; usability by a bounded receiver, which a transformation can raise; and pragmatic efficacy in the act; and where response models are singular, as Watanabe's theory treats, a missing response can come from an absent attempt or an unresponsive receiver alike, and only intervention or later dynamics separate them *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-199
- [CLAIM-141](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-141.md) — Causal-loop consistency and sheaf contextuality are both local-to-global problems, but passing to distributions affects them oppositely: a loop with no deterministic solution has a distributional fixed point, while a model with no global section in its supports has no global distribution either *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-342](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-342.md) — What keeps a judgement–observation loop from confirming itself is evidence whose arrival or scoring does not pass through the interpretation it tests; action is one source of such evidence, not a necessary one, and a loop that selects its own evidence can lock in with action available *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-330
    - [CLAIM-402](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-402.md) — Predictive success of a category across contexts warrants treating it as a real effective kind only when the evidence in those contexts does not pass through the category's own use, or when the effect of that use is modelled: a category that speakers or institutions act on can produce the regularities that confirm it, and contexts that share its use are not independent *(Active)*
      - [CLAIM-1223](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1223.md) — Replacing publication count with a count taken from a maintained record, of claims, corrections, endorsements or dependencies, reproduces the proxy problem it replaces, because researchers will shape the record to the count; an accountable history of contributions is evidence for an evaluation and not a score computed from the record *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-266
      - [CLAIM-619](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-619.md) — An organization can be disposed to answer a credible challenge by reducing the capacity for future challenge, classifying the challenge as the problem and restricting the challenger, so that the later absence of challenges reads as success; the test is whether a credible challenge causally lowers the chance of effective future challenge against a control, and the test alone does not say whether the response finks the disposition to be corrected, masks it, or changes only the challengers' access and incentives *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-406
      - [CLAIM-821](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-821.md) — Evidence that a system has learned a distinction certifies it only when scored against what the same measure shows with no learning, a null; a measure read without its null cannot certify *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-797, CLAIM-800
        - [CLAIM-831](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-831.md) — Scoring against a null is a case of certifying categories by a model of the effect of using them, the model being the null's account of what the measure shows without the effect *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-402
