        - [CLAIM-851](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-851.md) — Scoring against a null is a fourth route to certifying categories, beside evidence that does not pass through them, a model of the effect of using them, and an intervention *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-402
    - [CLAIM-413](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-413.md) — Grounding is not a property of an experience but a relation among an interpretation, what it purports to be about, and a process that constrains it independently; its current, developmental and epistemic senses come apart from one another, and in the current sense it comes apart from whether the interpretation occurs, so ungrounded is not unconstrained, and what makes an interpretive organization experiential need not be what makes its contents veridical *(Active)*
    - [CLAIM-873](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-873.md) — The independent scoring that keeps a judgement–observation loop from confirming itself is scoring that reads nothing of the loop's state, so share-dependent advantage is scoring that passes through what the loop tests, and authority that reinforces itself against independent evidence too weak to overturn it does not meet the defeater of the claim that such evidence is the anchor *(Proposed)*
    - [CLAIM-874](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-874.md) — Read by its wording and its formal anchor, the independent scoring that keeps a judgement–observation loop from confirming itself is scoring that does not read the interpretation, so share-dependent advantage counts as independent scoring, a loop whose authority reinforces itself against weak independent evidence meets the defeater of the claim that such evidence is the anchor, and that claim holds only for loops whose authority does not reinforce itself apart from the interpretation *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-330
- [CLAIM-148](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-148.md) — A matrix factorization is identified only up to an invertible change of latent coordinates, which weight decay narrows to rotations and nonnegativity to rescalings and permutations plus a data-dependent remainder; such a gauge is not a symmetry of the relational system, and automorphisms of the data act on the factors only when the factorization is identifiable *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-807](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-807.md) — A factored feature under weight decay, ŷ = abφ, switches on at a sharp threshold: its strength is q* = (s − λ)₊, the origin loses stability through a pitchfork in the parameters at s = λ, relaxation there is algebraic and the local coefficient of the regularized loss dips from 1 to 3/4, and just above threshold the feature's variance is of order ε² while its gain in fit is of order ε, so a newly active feature is quiet but consequential *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-811
    - [CLAIM-828](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-828.md) — When a fine feature's factored contribution is gated by a parent feature, ŷ = g·abφ, the child switches on only when gs > λ, so acquisition follows a partial order of dependencies rather than a fixed coarse-to-fine chronology; and the time a feature becomes unstable, the time it becomes visible and the time its information was first encoded can all differ *(Proposed)*
    - [CLAIM-837](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-837.md) — In the factored-feature model a feature switches on, and its regularized loss is singular, at the same point s = λ, but sample PCA detects the feature only further on: in the hidden layer once s − λ exceeds σ²√(D/N), and in its contribution to the output once (s − λ)² does, so over a window that narrows as the sample grows the feature is active and improves the fit while it stays inside the noise bulk *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-799
- [CLAIM-150](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-150.md) — An ontology of intrinsically individuated objects with relational properties can reproduce the categorical and operational identifications, and the predictions, of a relational one, so identification underdetermines constitution *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-152](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-152.md) — Any individuation built on sufficiency is relative to the target it is sufficient for: fix the outcomes differently and a different partition wins, so no boundary drawn this way is universal *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-157](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-157.md) — Relative to a stated target, a combined form is one system while its joint dynamics are nearly decomposable with the form as a block whose gap beats the Occam factor, and it lasts as long as that block persists; the unit is the gap-isolated block, not any member *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-154, CLAIM-164
    - [CLAIM-1153](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1153.md) — Whether a plurality of collectives is a pseudo-self or an ecosystem of pseudo-selves is relative to the regime it is analyzed under: the integration condition is indexed by a probe family and a horizon, so the same firms can be merely coupled at a short horizon and integrated at a long one, and at a fixed regime there is no further difference in kind *(Proposed)*
    - [CLAIM-174](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-174.md) — A candidate factor is an agent at a level when it is one system there, when a goal-directed description beats a device description by more than the Occam cost, and when its policy would adapt if its actions' consequences changed; it is a willed agent when, further, a will-organization over several regimes describes it better than none, and what passes that is the jurisdiction of a will-organization *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-154
      - [CLAIM-367](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-367.md) — Whether a training-time regulatory condition belongs to a network depends on which unit is individuated for the training dynamics and whose jurisdiction governs the updates; in conventional training most of that governance falls to the optimizer–model–data system, so a condition of training is not thereby a condition of the network *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-027, CLAIM-152, CLAIM-170
    - [CLAIM-870](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-870.md) — Taken as one system by the gap-isolated block test, the record does not individuate the Game of Life block, and the eater only at a one-generation horizon below a threshold Life does not set, so the Life constructions do not meet the first half of what would answer the achievement question and need another substrate or another criterion *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-869
    - [CLAIM-926](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-926.md) — On populations matched in turnover and aggregate statistics, a priced lagged block test finds a population held together by delayed transmission, with its lag, but rejects a commonly driven population only while the common input is observed, and gives a commonly driven population and an institutionally maintained one the same boundary *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-154
  - [CLAIM-405](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-405.md) — An individuation is well defined only once its criterion is fixed (the target it serves, the transformations its unity must survive, the scale), and that dependence does not make it arbitrary: once the criterion is fixed a verdict can be false, and differently fixed criteria can pick out units of one system whose boundaries cross rather than nest, none of them less real for it *(Active)*
    - [CLAIM-477](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-477.md) — Relata stand to relations as realizations stand to specifications: what an entity is, is partly fixed by the constraints on the configurations of entities and relations it can enter, and those constraints are themselves realized and maintained by something, so neither relata nor relations, nor specifications nor realizations, are prior without qualification *(Proposed)*
      - [CLAIM-478](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-478.md) — Rate differences help make structure and not only mark it: where some degrees of freedom settle faster than others by more than the rates vary among them, the relation they settle into is a constraint on the system over the window between the two rates, so what is a realization at one rate works as a constraint at another; and organization can make new rate differences in turn, as when modes slow near an instability and become order parameters, so hierarchies of rates and constraints can produce one another *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-331
        - [CLAIM-1122](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1122.md) — An adaptive interface need not trade inference latency against perceptual latency: if its learning runs off the input and rendering path and changes the interface's parameters only between actions, adaptation can take seconds while each response stays as fast as fixed physics; three timescales then come apart, the response, the adaptation and the evaluative horizon at which one can tell whether a command helped, and only the first is bounded by perception *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-711
        - [CLAIM-730](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-730.md) — Where a slowly revised governing level (a statute, an objective, a classification) constrains a fast process, the fast process can change the world before the slow level can be revised, so those it harms have no route to the rule as fast as its application reaches them, and the rule dominates them without anyone actively intervening; where the slow level is open to revision on demand, the same separation of timescales keeps the fast process accountable instead *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-423
        - [CLAIM-762](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-762.md) — Collapsing differences that do not matter into equivalence classes is how those classes come to be reified as new distinctions: where a process identifies its microstates by what they do, the classes it keeps, and not the microstates, become the units of further computation and organization; the claim is substantive only where the classes are closed under the system's own operations and are reused *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-154
        - [CLAIM-778](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-778.md) — An entry's local degrees of freedom are the features a restatement copies with error, neither pulled onto a convention nor copied exactly, and over its life cycle they are moved out of that part: the schema puts its form in the contracting part at filing, and its code, its verbatim reading and the relations that accrue on it put its content in the conserved part, so the revisions it can still take narrow like an inductive prior; an entry that has slowed works as a constraint on faster ones, and what narrows is its text, while its identity stays open to change by status *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-031, CLAIM-195, CLAIM-772, CLAIM-779
          - [CLAIM-785](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-785.md) — Adding a predicate to an entry is adding a constraint on its revisions: each field filled, relation drawn, status set, defeater stated and passage quoted is a test its later versions must pass, so as they accrue the revisions still open to it are an intersection that only shrinks, toward what the predicates say, which its filers chose; the inductive prior an entry develops is that intersection weighted by how hard each predicate is enforced, from prose convention to lint rule; accruing predicates stabilizes an entry, in the control-theoretic sense, in the dimensions they constrain, and narrowing it is not good in itself *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-772, CLAIM-783
            - [CLAIM-1049](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1049.md) — A governed record can stabilize collaborators' contributions and synchronize them without making their perspectives converge: it constrains revisions of the public record, not of anyone's perspective, so the record can approach full compliance with its constraints while the perspectives stay apart, and convergence, where it comes, can be on a regime of accountable disagreement rather than on one view *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-668
            - [CLAIM-942](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-942.md) — Inquiry and engineering differ by the direction of fit of their predicates, not in kind: inquiry adds predicates its object already passes and engineering imposes predicates its object must be made to pass, so the one difference the record draws between inquiry and specification, that inquiry can revise what an answer could be, recurs inside engineering whenever building shows an imposed requirement cannot be met and it is rewritten to describe what can *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-470, CLAIM-784, CLAIM-943
        - [CLAIM-781](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-781.md) — Rate differences between levels, where they exceed the rate differences within a level, do two jobs in a hierarchy: the ratio of the rate within a level's blocks to the rate between them is the margin by which the block aggregate is a slow manifold and the coarse variable closes, and its logarithm is the spacing between that level and the next in the tree the time geometry becomes; so dynamical hyperbolicity at every level makes the whole geometrically hyperbolic, which is how rate differences make hierarchical structure and not only mark it *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-157, CLAIM-386, CLAIM-581, CLAIM-770, CLAIM-780
          - [CLAIM-775](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-775.md) — A parameterization of a network allocates rates among its modules: it fixes the exponent with which each module's effect on its output changes per step as a power of width or depth, so the kernel regime is the case where the hidden body is slower than the readout by a factor growing with width, its features and kernel fixed and acting as a constraint on the fitting, μP is the case where no part, readout included, is slower by such a factor, and the modular norm sets the ratios among modules by hand, with width exponents fixed by each module's norm *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-478
      - [CLAIM-784](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-784.md) — Engineering is a form of inquiry: an inquiry in the record's sense whose answer space is the realizations of a specification, whose interventions are builds and whose observations are tests; it is reflexive, and so more than search, when building revises the specification, and it differs from inquiry into a given object in that its interventions make the object its observations judge *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-470
    - [CLAIM-529](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-529.md) — An organization can be individuated without presupposing it as a declared candidate whose verdict can come out false: criteria stated on the candidate's interactions (whether benefit can be booked per member, which interactions the others depend on, what removing an interaction type does, whether its order survives release from an outside scaffold) apply to a grouping not yet assumed to be a unit, while criteria stated as members' attitudes toward the group (a goal about it, belonging, identity) make it partly constituted by being taken as one, individuating it by a different relation, unavailable where members have no such attitudes *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-522
    - [CLAIM-871](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-871.md) — Taken in the descriptive and dynamical senses of individuation, relative to stated perturbations, the record individuates the Game of Life block and eater, so the Life constructions meet the first half of what would answer the achievement question for a formal system, provided a transient block is counted by the continuity of its cells *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-153](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-153.md) — Failure of a self to hold together across contexts is a monodromy around a cycle of contexts: any two locally consistent contexts glue, and the minimal model of the obstruction needs three *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-538](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-538.md) — On a finite graph of contexts whose overlaps carry preferred real offsets a and tolerances δ_e ≥ 0, an assignment within every tolerance, |Dx − a| ≤ δ, exists exactly when no cycle's holonomy exceeds the sum of its tolerances; with every δ_e > 0 the least uniform enlargement of the tolerances that admits one is the largest ratio, over simple cycles, of holonomy to summed tolerance, so the obstruction is certified by a cycle; the feasible allocations of tolerance depend on the offsets only through their class in H¹, so local adjustment can move a mismatch among the overlaps of a cycle and never remove it; and an evaluation that omits one overlap of every witnessing cycle reports a compatibility that does not hold *(Active)*
    - [CLAIM-1238](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1238.md) — Views whose correspondences all pass through one source satisfy the cocycle condition by construction, as charts of a given space do, while views related to one another pair by pair can be compatible on every overlap and inconsistent around a cycle of three, so an atlas of such views must check its compatibility on cycles and not only on pairs *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-153
    - [CLAIM-537](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-537.md) — In tolerance-bounded compatibility on a graph with disturbed offsets, |Dx − a₀ − w| ≤ δ for |w_e| ≤ η_e, a compatible configuration exists for every disturbance exactly when |cᵀa₀| + Σ η_e|c_e| ≤ Σ δ_e|c_e| on every cycle, and one configuration serves every disturbance exactly when η ≤ δ and |cᵀa₀| ≤ Σ(δ_e − η_e)|c_e|; an agent that chooses its configuration from what it observes needs the second condition within each class of disturbances it cannot tell apart, so whether a compatible state can be selected lies between the two and depends on what the agent can read *(Active)*
      - [CLAIM-628](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-628.md) — In tolerance-bounded compatibility on a graph with disturbed offsets, one configuration serves every disturbance in a class the agent cannot tell apart exactly when, on each overlap, the class's half-range of disturbance is within tolerance, and the cycle condition for compatibility holds for the class's midpoint offsets with each tolerance reduced by that half-range; whether a compatible configuration exists depends on a disturbance only through its cohomology class, but whether one can be selected depends on its edgewise spread, so an agent that reads the cohomology class exactly need not be able to select one *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-538
- [CLAIM-154](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-154.md) — A candidate structure is worth naming as a unit when its effect-to-noise ratio outruns the Occam cost of keeping it: reify when d'² exceeds the log prior-to-posterior variance ratio, where the model with the candidate stays regular at the parameters that switch it off *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-332](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-332.md) — A loosely organized population can change what an outside institution does through its members' separately motivated acts of making, selecting and passing things on, without forming a collective intention or judgment, when the organized pattern of those acts, and not only the acts of identifiable individuals, earns its place in explaining the change *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-160](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-160.md) — Data written for a potential future receiver has its intended meaning fixed by the write: even if it is never read, what it was meant to say was settled when it was stored *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-164](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-164.md) — What a spectral gap makes definite is the subspace of the cluster it isolates, not a single direction: the gap picks the object, and the object is a vector only when its own gap is wide *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-165](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-165.md) — A combined form constituted by mutual entrainment is not thereby a self in the subject sense: two dancers in phase are one coordination, an autonomous process, and still two subjects *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-169](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-169.md) — On Ainslie's account the population of interests is produced by desynchronized valuation, not given by a fixed architecture: an agent is many interests over a choice only as far as its valuations of that choice cross within the choice's horizon *(Proposed)*
  - [CLAIM-162](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-162.md) — In flow an activity's immediate reward and its longer-run value coincide, so no interest has to be overridden (synchronization as non-crossing valuations, with no dynamical mechanism claimed), and that is why focused action in flow is reported as effortless *(Proposed)* — through [ARG-016](../record/arguments.d/ARG-016.md)
    - [CLAIM-1200](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1200.md) — A governed record can bring a contributor's immediate reward in producing an idea closer to the longer-run value of a coherent inquiry, by making that structure consequential at the moment of contribution, and so supply, on the record's flow conjecture, a condition for flow in collaborative inquiry; the same record widens the gap when filing is tedious or its grammar distorts the idea *(Proposed)* — through [ARG-237](../record/arguments.d/ARG-237.md)
    - [CLAIM-441](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-441.md) — Flow tells against the potential account's condition that valence is undefined where no pair is contested: on the record's own account of flow nothing is overridden because an activity's immediate reward and its longer-run value coincide, yet flow is reported as positive, so either flow's positivity is intrinsic pleasantness and not goal-conduciveness valence, or flow keeps contested pairs its processes settle among themselves, or the positivity comes after the episode and not during it, or the condition is wrong *(Proposed)*
  - [CLAIM-198](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-198.md) — Preference reversal is not yet disunity: interests that govern a choice at disjoint times glue, and a self is divided over a choice only on an overlap, which the agent's prediction of its own later valuation creates *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-197
- [CLAIM-170](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-170.md) — The agents in a system are a factorization of it relative to a level of description and a target; agents in general are identified by adaptation, and willed agents are individuated by their will-organization: a willed agent is the jurisdiction of a will-organization *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-177](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-177.md) — In the record's exchanges with collaborators who keep no memory, the argument repeatedly loses identity: concepts are redefined silently, objections and readings come back as though new, and the thesis changes without anyone arguing for the change *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-178](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-178.md) — A manuscript should be a view over the argument and not its only copy: a draft written straight from an exchange drops commitments and changes its thesis without saying so, and both become visible only against a record where claims carry status and inclusion separately *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-324
    - [CLAIM-1263](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1263.md) — Coverage of a region of the record by views has four separable dimensions, source, argument, expository and transition coverage, each of which can be high while another is low, and a view's review status is a different thing from the standing of the claims it presents *(Proposed)*
    - [CLAIM-1283](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1283.md) — Scientific publishing should publish the work and not only the paper, as a hyperarticle, a living, versioned body of the work attributed at the level of each contribution, of which any article is one view, and Nucleation can be read as one *(Proposed)*
    - [CLAIM-1292](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1292.md) — A record that holds one tangle of interrelated ideas removes the reason to publish it as a flood of interrelated papers: the whole tangle can be offered for evaluation, and each party with its own interests given a view over it *(Proposed)*
      - [CLAIM-1258](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1258.md) — The form in which knowledge becomes institutionally legible is separated from the form in which it is productively developed, so a researcher who can sustain an inquiry and not its conversion into manuscripts meets a design choice of the publishing apparatus and not only a personal obstacle, and a record from which manuscripts are drawn as views reduces the separation *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-178
      - [CLAIM-1306](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1306.md) — Two views of the record should be separate scholarly contributions only when they have different central claims needing different evidence; that audiences want different presentations is a reason for different views, not different contributions, so an atlas of the record is organized around a few primary arguments with focused, cross-cutting and frontier views beside them rather than as a list of paper titles *(Proposed)*
    - [CLAIM-183](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-183.md) — Generated views of the record, fed back into the exchange, become instruments of the argument: they show where its terms evolved faster than its formalism *(Proposed)*
    - [CLAIM-189](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-189.md) — Fidelity is the wrong measure of a developing argument: maturing drops and changes things legitimately, so what a record can secure is traceability, change that is announced and located, not preservation *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-034, CLAIM-270
  - [CLAIM-182](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-182.md) — Storage is not anchoring, addressability is: a structure that is kept but cannot be pointed at part by part does not stop re-derivation, and the same content becomes an anchor once its parts get addresses *(Proposed)*
    - [CLAIM-180](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-180.md) — Drift is retrieval failure outside a critical distance: a restatement close enough to an idea retrieves it, one that has drifted too far is taken for new, and a code bypasses retrieval by content altogether *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-177
    - [CLAIM-191](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-191.md) — Restating an argument across memoryless sessions is iterated transport with only a weak channel back to the source: without anchors, restatements drift toward the collaborators' own framings rather than at random, and a code restores continuity of transmission *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-002, CLAIM-090, CLAIM-177, CLAIM-267, CLAIM-270
      - [CLAIM-772](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-772.md) — Forgetting a source and anchoring to it are one contraction, told apart by what each restatement step conserves exactly: a chain that contracts everywhere except on what its steps copy without error ends keeping exactly the start's value on that conserved part, so it is anchored where the source's features lie in the part and forgets them where they do not; the record copies content exactly, by code and verbatim reading, and leaves form to contract onto its schema *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-068, CLAIM-107, CLAIM-181, CLAIM-635, CLAIM-779; also argued from CLAIM-107, CLAIM-635, CLAIM-779
        - [CLAIM-768](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-768.md) — That an entry has stopped changing does not show what stopped it: settling is the decay of its contracted features onto the convention, and retention is the start's value on what is copied exactly, so contraction and conservation both settle an entry and are told apart only by retention against a reference fixed outside the record's later restatements, measured as a diagnostic of mechanism and not as a standard of quality *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-081, CLAIM-270, CLAIM-635
        - [CLAIM-776](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-776.md) — In the record's exchanges, the ideas lost soonest, re-derived as though new or silently redefined, are those furthest from the collaborators' own framings: contraction toward those framings carries a distant idea past the critical distance in a few restatements and never carries a near one past it, so the most original ideas are the most fragile until coded *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-180, CLAIM-191, CLAIM-773
      - [CLAIM-790](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-790.md) — In any inquiry, anchoring is one mechanism, a fixed reference that each reconstruction is pulled toward, and what it secures is set by what the reference is tied to: tied to the target by a channel independent of the inquirer, it gives the inquiry's states content and makes a discrepancy register; tied to an earlier state of the inquiry, it gives continuity and not correctness; tied to nothing, it is bias *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-011, CLAIM-184, CLAIM-185, CLAIM-315
      - [CLAIM-793](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-793.md) — Where an inquiry keeps its sources and each step reads the stored source rather than the last restatement of it, re-reading is not a second route beside conservation but conservation on the state enlarged by the source; on that structure an interpretation does not drift but settles on a fixed offset from the source toward the reader's prior, the same at every reading, which no reader sharing that prior can see, and drift is confined to the chains of derived texts *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-182, CLAIM-635
  - [CLAIM-185](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-185.md) — The nucleation threshold of an argument is whatever makes a structure persist: a persistent structure is available as an anchor, and more complex structure can evolve only on anchors *(Proposed)*
    - [CLAIM-176](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-176.md) — Recurrence is the trigger of persistence this record is built around: coding a thing the second time it turns up captures exactly the drift that defeats an argument, and keeps capture from flooding the record *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-177, CLAIM-483
      - [CLAIM-630](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-630.md) — Where filing an argument costs at least twice what one reconstruction overpays, the break-even filing rule files it later than its second occurrence, and every reconstruction it pays for in between is a restatement with nothing filed to check it against: the cost-competitive rule and the drift-catching second-occurrence rule part exactly when filing is that dear, and the competitive guarantee prices none of the drift between them *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-177, CLAIM-308
  - [CLAIM-186](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-186.md) — How fast an argument grows sets how it grows: drift tracks how fast new material arrives relative to how fast it is anchored, so a fast, prolific exchange branches, as a crystal grown far from equilibrium does, and a project memory stabilizes an argument by keeping anchoring up with arrival *(Proposed)*
  - [CLAIM-483](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-483.md) — An argument developed with collaborators who keep no memory fails mainly at identity and not at structure, so that coding what recurs, not argument mapping, is the remedy, and this holds beyond one owner and one assistant family *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-181](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-181.md) — The record fixes the grammar an argument is expressed in, though not its shape: its closed vocabulary of schemes, roles and relations formalizes early, and a move that fits no CLAIM, TERM, ARG or declared relation is forced into one or lost until the misfit is noticed and the grammar amended to hold it *(Proposed)*
  - [CLAIM-190](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-190.md) — The anchoring measures are computed in the grammar that shapes the argument, so by themselves they cannot certify that drift fell: drift must also be judged under standards the record did not supply *(Superseded)* — also rests on CLAIM-264, CLAIM-266
- [CLAIM-184](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-184.md) — Anchors entrench: a structure that persists early can lock in its framing, so that later structure grows on it and alternatives become hard to reach, and retirement by status is the record's remedy only if superseded anchors stop attracting new structure *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-197](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-197.md) — Sections over contexts that do not overlap always glue, so a sense that differs between disjoint contexts is not a gluing failure: a failure needs an overlap carrying sections that disagree, and which families count as covers decides whether anything glues *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-196](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-196.md) — A person's roles in contexts that do not meet cannot contradict one another: role conflict needs an overlap, which segregating audiences prevents and collapsed contexts create *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-317
- [CLAIM-199](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-199.md) — Blackwell's order bounds what a rendering makes possible for any receiver, and a given receiver's access is usable information relative to the rules it can apply, which a garbling can raise for that receiver but never above what the source makes possible *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-839](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-839.md) — Progressive learning can be described by two partial orders, semantic entailment among the regions a representation assigns and informational refinement among its checkpoints in Blackwell's sense, neither of which need be a chain: learning is then the construction of an increasingly informative branching order of distinctions, and a narrower region counts as progress only while it stays correct *(Proposed)* — also argued from CLAIM-838, CLAIM-860
- [CLAIM-261](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-261.md) — Synchronization of an agent's interests is desirable, but not necessary for acting as one: internal conflict shows a human agent acting while its interests stay divided *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-358](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-358.md) — Learned local accommodation can reduce the amortized cost of recurrent arbitration: where a recurring conflict among an agent's processes admits a stable accommodation, settling it among the processes can cost less over repeated encounters than escalating each instance to a higher-level process that mediates or overrides, though local negotiation and the relations it needs are not free *(Proposed)*
    - [CLAIM-362](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-362.md) — Non-domination of an agent's subcomponents is a candidate constituent of authenticity as an organizational achievement, not a sufficient criterion of ownership: higher-level processes need not impose the outcome because the lower-level ones already support it or settle their disagreement among themselves, and a process that rarely decides keeps access to the roles in which it is consequential *(Proposed)* — through [ARG-030](../record/arguments.d/ARG-030.md)
- [CLAIM-263](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-263.md) — Whether two trained networks compute the same way can be tested by quotienting the architecture's full symmetry group and measuring what remains: a barrier that survives alignment marks a different mechanism, connection after alignment means shared feature structure, and the test cannot run where features have no counterpart *(Proposed)*
  - [CLAIM-187](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-187.md) — Whether two systems compute the same way can be tested by quotienting the full admissible symmetry group and measuring what remains: a residual barrier marks a different mechanism, and a feature with no counterpart blocks the comparison *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-264
- [CLAIM-264](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-264.md) — Two objects can agree on every probe in a restricted family without being isomorphic, so equivalence under a probe family is coarser than identity unless the family is rich enough *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-1046](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1046.md) — The observational partitions a family of affordable probes induces are not the lattice of possible decompositions: the map from probe subsets to partitions sends a union of families to the common refinement of their partitions, but an intersection of families to a partition that can be strictly coarser than the finest common coarsening, so its image is closed under meets and not under joins, and with m probes it has at most 2^m members against the Bell number of partitions of the configurations *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-322](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-322.md) — Agreement under a probe family is evidence that two objects share structure only to the degree that the family was chosen independently of the comparison and is evaluated on cases it was not chosen on, so a family selected to make two objects look alike shows only that it can be selected *(Active)*
    - [CLAIM-142](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-142.md) — Two communicative realizations can agree on every probe in a restricted family without being structurally identical, so observational equivalence is relative to the probes, and only independently justified probes evaluated on held-out cases are evidence that structure was preserved *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-011, CLAIM-046, CLAIM-264
      - [CLAIM-129](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-129.md) — A factorization recovers only the structure visible in the relations it is fitted to, so a topic can survive a transformation that changes the communicative act, and a kind must be tested against probe families chosen for their bearing on the act *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-004, CLAIM-061
      - [CLAIM-133](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-133.md) — Communicative identity is relational continuity under admissible transformation: translation transports relationally organized observational structure, correspondence fixes what can be compared, admissibility which transformations count, and fidelity which communicatively consequential distinctions remain recoverable *(Superseded)* — also rests on CLAIM-011, CLAIM-050, CLAIM-077, CLAIM-143
      - [CLAIM-139](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-139.md) — A communicative kind's identity is grounded in its relational organization rather than in any expression or encoding; statistical methods recover aspects of that organization from restricted observations, translation transports it, and fidelity is which independently identifiable, decision-relevant relational distinctions persist *(Superseded)* — through [ARG-029](../record/arguments.d/ARG-029.md) — also rests on CLAIM-050, CLAIM-077, CLAIM-135, CLAIM-151; also argued from CLAIM-046, CLAIM-112
      - [CLAIM-204](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-204.md) — A communicative kind's identity is grounded in its relational organization, for which competent participants' uptake is the standard; statistical methods recover aspects of it from restricted observations; translation transports it; and what persists is what the receivers can still recover, of which the analyst can certify the independently identifiable part *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-050, CLAIM-077, CLAIM-135, CLAIM-151, CLAIM-217, CLAIM-223
      - [CLAIM-964](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-964.md) — A pragmatic rendering experiment's operational equivalences, equal probe predictabilities in the four sign patterns plus one mixture equivalence among renderings, imply a generalized-noncontextuality inequality bounding the sum of the two probe predictabilities by one, a preparation-contextuality test separate from and invisible to the sheaf criterion *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-044, CLAIM-046
  - [CLAIM-574](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-574.md) — Distinctions drawn by restricted Yoneda profiles only grow as nested probe families grow: a natural isomorphism of profiles on a probe subcategory restricts to one on every subcategory of it, so objects equivalent under a larger family are equivalent under each smaller one and objects told apart at a lower budget stay apart at every higher one; an equivalence a richer regime breaks was relative to its regime, not false; and the monotonicity needs an every-probe comparison, which an averaged distortion is not *(Active)*
    - [CLAIM-1196](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1196.md) — A self may be considered as a sloppy mess of connected perspectives: overlapping, partly coordinated and interfering perspectives with no clean boundaries between them and no single executive over them, and since what can separate one perspective from another is relative to the tests that can be afforded, so is the self's apparent division into them *(Proposed)*
      - [CLAIM-1179](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1179.md) — Collective identity may be a sloppy mess of governed perspectives, that is, a pseudo-self, playing a question–answer game *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-1031
    - [CLAIM-557](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-557.md) — More resource for observing splits what can be told apart, and more resource for acting merges what can be turned into one another, so a system's budgeted individuation runs in opposite directions from outside and from inside and is indexed by a pair of budgets, not one *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-581
    - [CLAIM-570](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-570.md) — With observational indistinguishability refining as the observing budget grows and peak-cost mutual reachability coarsening as the acting budget grows, the budget pairs at which everything indistinguishable is mutually reachable form an up-set and those at which everything mutually reachable is indistinguishable form a down-set, with boundaries given by the largest peak distance within an observational class and the least observing budget that separates two mutually reachable states *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-581
      - [CLAIM-572](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-572.md) — When observing and acting draw on one budget, the cheapest readiness always buys a whole prefix of the probes and stops where a probe lowers the response budget, the splits a fixed budget affords can be disconnected, so shifting resources gradually from response to observation can pass through splits that are not ready, and stopping when the next probe does not pay can miss the optimum *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-535, CLAIM-574
      - [CLAIM-592](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-592.md) — Whether a system's own reachable classes ever coincide with what an observer can tell apart depends on the order of the observer's probe costs as well as on the mechanism: the two partitions agree exactly at partitions common to the observer's refinement chain and the system's merge tree, a level of the merge tree can be made to agree under some cost order exactly when it is the common refinement of some set of the available probes, and the cost order decides which of those levels actually appear *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-574, CLAIM-581
        - [CLAIM-639](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-639.md) — Knowing each configuration's requirement to within ε fixes every transition threshold to within ε but not which of a system's own reachable classes an observer's partitions can agree with: where two merges of the merge tree lie within 2ε of each other, an error within ε can reorder them, replacing a level that agrees under some order of probe costs with one that agrees under none *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-580, CLAIM-581
    - [CLAIM-999](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-999.md) — A distinction among a self's perspectives cannot disappear as a probe regime is enriched along a nested family: it can disappear only when the regime changes otherwise, by dropping or replacing probes, coarsening what is recorded or shortening the horizon, which are changes of regime under which it is relative and not false, or when the organization itself changes, in which case it was a fact about the earlier organization and is not relative to any regime *(Active)* — through [ARG-239](../record/arguments.d/ARG-239.md)
- [CLAIM-265](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-265.md) — Local descriptions that disagree are not thereby incompatible: whether they obstruct a joint description is decided only relative to a specified class of admissible correspondences between their observations, and a correspondence admitted only because it removes the disagreement decides nothing *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-266](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-266.md) — A family of probes that supplies an optimized system's training signal cannot also certify what the system preserves: optimization pushes toward whatever the probes reward, including what they cannot see, so preservation must be shown under probes not used to train it *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-267](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-267.md) — Per-step discrepancies between a chain of maps and a reference chain compound through the sensitivity of the later steps, so the same local error can be damped, accumulated or amplified, and closeness at every step can coexist with large end-to-end divergence *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-268](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-268.md) — Model stitching certifies an order of information only in its reconstruction form: a map fitted to reproduce the target layers shows the source representation is at least as informative for every decision on the label, task-loss stitching compares one decision problem through a fixed head, and a failure to stitch is no evidence against sufficiency *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-270](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-270.md) — Retaining information about where a Markov chain started and staying close to the starting distribution are different properties: a chain can forget its initial state while its distribution stays far from where it began, so convergence is not preservation and losing information about the origin is not degradation *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-225](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-225.md) — Blackwell's order measures what an ideal decision-maker could do, not what a given receiver can reconstruct, and the line's claims that a rendering can improve access describe garblings that real receivers do better with, which is the shape of the Blackwell thesis's own defeat condition *(Active)*
    - [CLAIM-087](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-087.md) — Cross-modal reconstruction often improves a receiver's access to an implicit communicative relation beyond the text-only baseline, as when posture or expression conveys solidarity better than the source text's literal content, though a rendering made without the situation is a garbling and cannot improve what an ideal receiver could do *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-275](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-275.md) — An intervention can come before the interpretation it makes available, so in an organization of processes meaning, policy and influence can co-evolve, and none of them is upstream of the others in every case *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-430](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-430.md) — An interaction can make available a way of relating that its participants' operative perspectives did not hold, by giving each a role to enact in it, so that taking part can come before, and help produce, the reinterpretation it later seems to express; whether the change stays with the partner, generalizes to a category, or is reproduced beyond the encounter are further questions *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-279](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-279.md) — Whether an intervention stabilizes or destabilizes a pattern is relative to a policy and a frame, so denoiser, critic and re-noiser are regimes an operator falls into, not kinds of operator *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-280](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-280.md) — A pattern can persist while every constituent is replaced and some constituents work against it, as a high-turnover regime of damage and repair, so the persistence of a product and the persistence of the organization producing it are separate facts *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-621](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-621.md) — An expression's reproduction can come apart from agreement on the concept it carries: communities that use it against one another, and contest whom it describes, can keep it in circulation, so symbolic stability can persist while conceptual stability fails, and a durable dispute over a term shows a durable relation among its uses, not one concept *(Proposed)*
  - [CLAIM-983](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-983.md) — In the transmission criterion of identity over time, a maintainer that restores an individual from the organization it finds in it is a channel of transmission, never part of what is transmitted, so replacing the maintainer with an unrelated one breaks no continuation and the criterion is met or failed by the path through the individual itself *(Proposed)* — through [ARG-216](../record/arguments.d/ARG-216.md) — also rests on CLAIM-329; also argued from CLAIM-329
- [CLAIM-282](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-282.md) — Forbidding self-granting does not stop an operator from amplifying its own authority: under damped recursive delegation, reciprocal and cyclic grants recycle authority, so an operator's authority depends on its own grants, while one-hop allocation within an epoch, from budgets and baselines fixed independently of outgoing grants, makes it exactly independent of them *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-277](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-277.md) — Durable authority among an organization's processes need not be a primitive: trust can be the temporal regularity of grants that policies earn by being right often, and the same loop entrenches whatever gained influence early *(Active)*
    - [CLAIM-297](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-297.md) — When an operator's authority is updated by how well it performs on the interpretation it helped make dominant, the coupled meaning and influence of an organization can amplify an initial interpretive advantage without any gain in fidelity to independent evidence *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-275
      - [CLAIM-336](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-336.md) — The pragmatic-transport and will-organization lines describe one model, an organization of operators that act on a shared interpretive state under a context while allocating one another's influence: a frame is the context under which operators act, a judgement is the response they yield, an action-generating regime is an operator or coalition, and a will-organization is the dynamics that allocates influence among them *(Proposed)* — through [ARG-065](../record/arguments.d/ARG-065.md) — also rests on CLAIM-279, CLAIM-286; also argued from CLAIM-330, CLAIM-407, CLAIM-414, CLAIM-421
        - [CLAIM-338](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-338.md) — The selectivity active inference gives action, sampling what one expects to experience, is played in the coupled meaning–authority model by the authority space: influence decides which operators retrieve and so what the next judgement observes, which makes Friston's self-confirming sampling the model's authority-to-interpretation arrow and his agent a coupled loop run without independent scoring *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-297
      - [CLAIM-341](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-341.md) — The loop that keeps a lucid agent's model in touch with what it models runs between judgement and observation: each judgement reshapes the observer whose later observations it then judges, and action on the world is not part of that loop, so active inference's action–perception cycle misplaces where the agent is active *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-275
      - [CLAIM-429](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-429.md) — Where interpretation decides the occasions for cooperation and cooperation's outcomes revise interpretation, an intervention can change the loop's state or its coupling: a favourable exception changes the state and leaves the rule that judges exceptions as it was, while a change in how far outcomes may revise the governing interpretation changes the coupling, and where the coupling does not depend on the state, only the second changes how later evidence is taken *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-330
      - [CLAIM-888](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-888.md) — In the coupled meaning–influence model, where each operator's authority is scored against the interpretation it helped make dominant, a governance intervention's later effect on a response under a new frame takes the sign of the treated operator's reading there and survives in proportion to the operators' dissent under the frames passed through, growing where η·Δa²/2 > κ; so separate interpretation and governance models of matched complexity and training data mispredict held-out compositions of interventions and frame changes when that loop is present, and gain nothing on the joint model when it is absent *(Proposed)*
    - [CLAIM-406](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-406.md) — Structural, pre-emptive testimonial injustice has the form of the record's trust loop: an arrangement that decides whose word is sought can keep an early exclusion going through the indicators of competence that only being sought produces, with no continuing prejudiced act; but the loop alone cannot tell perpetuated privilege from merited expertise, because that needs the prejudice condition the dynamics do not contain *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-330
    - [CLAIM-443](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-443.md) — A learned prior over which processes govern, P(g | z, H) ∝ exp(βQ(g, z) + b_H(g, z)), its bias b_H trained by reward-modulated Hebbian updates to the relations by which one process recruits another or grants it influence, is a candidate mechanism for durable authority and for amortized governance; but persistence is not amortization, which is shown only when earlier work replaces later computation, communication or recruitment, and a prior over authority differs from a prior over actions only when what is appropriate changes *(Active)*
      - [CLAIM-1303](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1303.md) — Beside heuristics that select what to do there are governance heuristics, learned priors over which perspective or procedure determines what to do; intuitive expertise and entrenched bias can then be one learned allocation of authority, efficient where the conditions it was learned under still hold and a source of systematic error where they no longer do *(Proposed)*
        - [CLAIM-1341](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1341.md) — A heuristic can be a compiled contract, a protocol that settles a recurring conflict among processes without renegotiating it, and some biases can be such a protocol still governing where the assumptions that made it adequate no longer hold *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-1239, CLAIM-358
  - [CLAIM-375](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-375.md) — Under one-hop allocation within an epoch, an operator that grants influence to an ally whose policy is nearer its own than the collective decision is raises how far its preferred policy is realized while its own authority stays fixed, so the two conditions of the grant scheme hold together *(Active)*
    - [CLAIM-1147](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1147.md) — Operators rewarded for realized policy under a weighted-mean decision delegate, within their own side, to its most extreme members and not its nearest, because a grant's marginal value to the granter is proportional to how far the grantee's policy lies from the decision *(Active)*
    - [CLAIM-285](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-285.md) — A grant scheme that denies each operator control over its own authority can make delegation do work: rewarded for how far their preferred policies are realized and not for authority held, operators delegate to aligned others, and the two conditions need not be confined to one-hop allocation *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-282, CLAIM-502
- [CLAIM-283](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-283.md) — The precedence a motive claims over action and the authority the rest of the organization grants it are different quantities: a motive can claim control without receiving it, and be granted control it does not claim *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-484](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-484.md) — Internal conflict is the gap between the precedence a motive claims over action and the authority the rest of the organization grants it *(Proposed)*
  - [CLAIM-548](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-548.md) — A motivational process can become active, and act, without any expectation that its response will succeed: its activation, the authority the organization grants it and the efficacy of what it does are separate quantities, so a threshold on expected net benefit is one special case of an activation threshold and not its general form *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-286](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-286.md) — Habit, akrasia, rumination, rigidity and insight can be modelled as regimes of one organization, in which processes transform shared meaning and allocate one another's influence, with trust, specialization and higher-level agency arising from its history and not imposed *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-287](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-287.md) — What persists when a self persists through inactivity is the capacity to reinstate an organization, not its continuous running, and continuity of that kind can branch and merge, so it is not an identity relation *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-290](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-290.md) — A positive-definite kernel's minimal realizations are unique up to a unitary, and two finite representation matrices with the same centred Gram matrix differ by a translation and an orthogonal map *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-379](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-379.md) — On a finite set of stimuli, regularized linear readouts with ridge b > 0 cannot tell apart two centred representations of the same width exactly when one is an orthogonal transformation of the other, and the unregularized CCA member cannot tell apart representations with the same column space, which differ by an invertible linear map *(Active)*
    - [CLAIM-269](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-269.md) — A regularized linear readout can tell apart only representations that differ in normalized kernel, and kernels fix a representation only up to the symmetry of what is observed, so no such readout supplies a distinction beyond that symmetry *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-385
      - [CLAIM-193](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-193.md) — A linear probe family can tell apart only realizations whose representations differ in normalized kernel, and kernels fix a representation only up to the symmetry of what is observed: any distinction beyond that is supplied by the analyst *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-264
- [CLAIM-296](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-296.md) — What a system has, what it knows it has, and what it can deploy within a task's deadline are different, and the last is a relation among the resource, the agent, its environment, the task, the deadline and the cue, not a property of any one of them *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-1100](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1100.md) — Whether information a learning system stores is knowledge depends on whether the procedures the declared system may use, within a declared budget, bring it to bear as a premise, not on whether it can be decoded: knowing is relative to the declared system and budget, and decodability by an outside probe makes information stored, not known *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-697
- [CLAIM-302](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-302.md) — Equivalence under feasible tests can be much coarser than statistical equivalence: there are ensembles almost disjoint from uniform that no polynomial-size test tells apart from it, and efficiently samplable ensembles of this kind exist if pseudorandom generators do *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-304](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-304.md) — A rendering can keep a distinction recoverable in principle and make it infeasible to recover: if pseudorandom generators exist, a uniformly random bit can be encoded so that an unbounded receiver recovers it except with probability at most 2⁻⁽ⁿ⁺¹⁾, while no efficient receiver does non-negligibly better than chance *(Active)*
    - [CLAIM-401](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-401.md) — The conditions an effective description is commonly asked to meet are not of one kind: predictive sufficiency and approximation fidelity are adequacy relative to a declared target, metric and horizon; tractability restricts the operations under which adequacy is assessed; dynamical independence and memory closure are relations of the representation to the system, memory relative to a chosen projection; so a matrix over them as independent binary axes conflates kinds *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-152, CLAIM-348, CLAIM-397
- [CLAIM-303](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-303.md) — Filing an argument moves work across time: it is paid for now, in filing, indexing, tracking dependencies and checking it is still current, against reconstruction later, so it is worth its cost only when expected reuse covers it, and where reuse can be forecast, recurrence is evidence of reuse, not the criterion *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-756](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-756.md) — An acquisition can be worth making for what it does to the cost of other acquisitions: valued only by its own savings on a fixed task distribution, a learning step that lowers the cost of a later one can show a loss, and the ranking of learning policies can reverse once its effect on later acquisitions is counted *(Proposed)*
  - [CLAIM-760](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-760.md) — That an organization makes an activity cheaper for those who perform it does not show that work was saved: the work may have been transferred, to an earlier time, to upkeep, or to other parties, and the efficiency an organization appears to have depends on the boundary of the system whose costs are counted; work saved, work transferred and valuable capability expanded are three separate achievements *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-307](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-307.md) — Retrieval pressure and evidence are different criteria for carving a category, and they move in opposite directions with copy count: evidence that a distinction exists grows with its copies, the search a bin saves shrinks with them, so the bins a deadline forces are often the ones the data least supports *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-308](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-308.md) — Where reuse cannot be forecast, recurrence weighted by reconstruction cost is the filing criterion, not only evidence for one: filing at the first use at which reconstructing again would take the overpayment past the cost of filing is within 2 − (c_a + u)/c_r of the hindsight optimum on every sequence of uses, at most twice, and no deterministic rule without foresight guarantees materially better, under fixed known costs, with staleness left out and the cost of recognizing what a filed argument answers taken as fixed *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-315](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-315.md) — In comparative anchoring tasks, considering an anchor shifts the later numerical estimate without adding evidence about the target, and the shift is carried by anchor-consistent knowledge made more accessible; the shift is established, the accessibility step is inferred and has not been measured *(Proposed)*
  - [CLAIM-298](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-298.md) — A frame can change a judgement by changing which of an interpreter's stored distinctions are reachable, without supplying any evidence about what is being judged *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-317](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-317.md) — Self-presentations that differ by audience do no harm while the audiences are kept apart; people keep them apart and script the occasions where they must meet, and broadcast and networked media bring them together unchosen, which is when the presentations collide *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-318](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-318.md) — Within a shared observational scenario, exact structure-preserving symmetries are the invertible members of a nested family of stochastic transports, and among Markov kernels between finite sets the invertible ones are the permutation matrices, so the invertible core is the relabellings, a groupoid in which objects joined by an arrow have isomorphic automorphism groups *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-324](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-324.md) — In the What Survives Translation? exchange, the manuscript drafted straight from the crystallized argument changed the thesis with no turn arguing the move and dropped 24 of that argument's items, none on request, and the second crystallized argument announced its change of question but left items out without saying which had dissolved and which were lost *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-327](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-327.md) — A slowly changing collective variable, such as a reputation, a rivalry or a standing, is part of a collective's dynamics and not only an observer's average when its members read it, condition what they do on it, and by doing so regenerate it *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-328](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-328.md) — When the continuities that ordinarily come bundled in a collective (legal franchise, civic role, interpersonal transmission, narrative and place) are separated, several later collectives can each be a genuine successor of the earlier one in a different respect, without any of them, or the earlier collective, having branched in numerical identity *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-329](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-329.md) — A collective that replaces all its members persists, when it does, by causal transmission of the organization that produces it, not by resemblance: an organization of the same kind that arises independently is not its continuation, and a lapse in its coherence need not end it *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-330](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-330.md) — In the coupled meaning–influence model linearized at its symmetric state, with each field stable alone and nonnegative couplings, the coupling destabilizes symmetry exactly when βγ > (1 − α)(1 − δ): only the loop can do it, and the direction that grows mixes meaning and authority *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-340](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-340.md) — Scoring operators on predictions committed before the evidence is not by itself Regime B: in the linearized operator model the coupling of interpretation to conferral has the sign of κ′ − κ̄, so commitment removes capture only when the interpretation bends the reading of the evidence no more than it bends the predictions, and it keeps the learning that revising after the evidence would lose *(Active)*
    - [CLAIM-400](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-400.md) — In the meaning–authority model linearized at symmetry, a third, maintained legibility state that authority moves (ε) and that moves interpretation (ν) or conferral (μ), with persistence λ < 1 and nonnegative couplings, destabilizes the symmetric state exactly when the two-variable condition holds with β + νε/(1 − λ) in place of β and δ + με/(1 − λ) in place of δ: at the threshold the regime is indistinguishable from stronger two-variable couplings, and the slower it is the more it adds, while away from the threshold it adds a mode that no two-variable model has, so a lean in the regime can outlast the advantages it was built from *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-330
      - [CLAIM-444](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-444.md) — A replicator dynamic on the distribution of authority among an organization's processes is the special case of the meaning–authority–legibility model in which the organization's interpretation is the authority-weighted mixture of its processes', evidence reaches scoring without a maintained regime of its own, and every process is scored on every step by one standard; the replicator tools (Bayesian reading, potential and harmonic games, stochastic stability) then apply to its expected motion, and the record's separate interpretation and legibility states earn their place exactly where interpretation departs from that mixture or legibility keeps a memory of past authority *(Active)*
    - [CLAIM-404](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-404.md) — An organization can be governed from outside without any of its decisions being made for it, through the evidence its own procedures receive or through the criteria by which they weigh evidence; the two routes are distinct and each is possible without the other, so informational and evaluative independence do not imply each other; and where the organization's role is to evaluate another that affects its evidence or resources, the interpretation–authority loop can close between the two institutions, so that formal independence of the evaluator's procedure does not make its evaluation independent *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-330, CLAIM-342, CLAIM-348, CLAIM-410
      - [CLAIM-1307](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1307.md) — Reflexive control can act on how a target's characteristic organization forms, not only on the evidence, criteria or circumstances of its decisions: a transmissible expression the target takes up can seed interpretive, evidence-selecting and authority-allocating dispositions that the target then maintains itself, so the influence outlasts its source, reaches circumstances the intervention never presented, and leaves formation provenance outside while maintenance is the target's own *(Proposed)* — through [ARG-242](../record/arguments.d/ARG-242.md) — also rests on CLAIM-1218
      - [CLAIM-545](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-545.md) — Freedom of will, in the operational sense, is an agent's governance of its own governability: the extent to which its own organization makes the relevant distinctions legible, gives the demands they raise practical efficacy, directs its transitions, and revises the relations that govern those three, including under another's interference; openness, sensitivity and controllability of outcomes each fall short of it, and domination is another's capacity to govern those same relations, used or not *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-025, CLAIM-027, CLAIM-354, CLAIM-424, CLAIM-485, CLAIM-523, CLAIM-533
        - [CLAIM-544](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-544.md) — If a willed agent is the jurisdiction of its will-organization, then governing one's own governability is in part governing one's own individuation, in the constitutive sense of individuation at that level: a revision of the will-organization that changes which regimes it governs changes which willed agent there is, so a self-forming revision can be a re-individuation and not only a change in an agent's states, and whether the revised jurisdiction continues the earlier agent is a question of continuation, not of resemblance *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-170
        - [CLAIM-610](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-610.md) — If the record's hypotheses held, agency and autonomy would be further organizations of the same individuated unit: the relations deciding which of an individual's interventions become effective would belong to that individual under the criterion that individuates it, and the governance of governability would act on those relations; persistence is transmission, and none of the achievements implies the next *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-025, CLAIM-027, CLAIM-329, CLAIM-405, CLAIM-474
        - [CLAIM-866](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-866.md) — An alternative: another party's standing channel into an agent's governing relations is itself a relation of its will-organization, so a manipulation that keeps its channel, as Pereboom's first case does, differs from its unmanipulated twin in present structure, testable by an intervention on the channel or by what the channel reaches, and only a manipulation that withdraws its channel is invisible to it *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-542, CLAIM-868
- [CLAIM-331](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-331.md) — A level of organization has a temporal facet as well as a compositional one: higher-level variables are characteristically slower and longer-lived than the activity that produces them, though slowness is a mark of a level and not its definition *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-423](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-423.md) — In a political collective, components that change at different speeds (attention, coalitions, elected terms, administrative careers, law and treaties, generational memory) are not only nested by timescale: under a given institutional arrangement their different temporal horizons affect which forms of influence each can accumulate, exercise and keep, and so which of them holds authority over the others, so a state can stay continuous as an actor while the organization producing its positions changes under it *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-345](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-345.md) — Equal controllability rank does not fix the cost of control: for x_{t+1} = x_t + b·u the least quadratic effort for a displacement Δ is Δ²/b², unbounded as b → 0 while the system stays controllable, and in general the least effort is Δxᵀ W_T^† Δx, set by the Gramian and not by its rank *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-1192](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1192.md) — A mode's slowness says how it persists, not how hard it is to redirect: for ȧ = −γa + bu the least quadratic effort to move a from 0 to Δ by time H is 2γΔ²/(b²(1 − e^{−2γH})), which falls as γ falls, so a slower mode is cheaper to redirect through the same input, and a mode with b = 0 cannot be redirected through it at any rate; persistence, redirection and the renewal of a mode's supports are three timescales that need not coincide *(Active)*
    - [CLAIM-1082](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1082.md) — Where an organization's operation relaxes at rate γ toward a governed configuration h(θ) and can also be pushed directly, ẋ = −γ(x − h(θ)) + bu, a smaller γ makes a direct push cheaper and a change of the configuration slower: the least effort to push x by Δ within H, 2γΔ²/(b²(1 − e^{−2γH})), rises with γ, while moving the configuration by D with operation kept within ε of it throughout needs H ≥ (D/ε − 2)/γ, so an organization whose operation has slowed is easier to redirect by intervention and slower to govern by changing its rules *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-1051
  - [CLAIM-542](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-542.md) — Sensitivity does not fix the allocation or the authorship of control: linearized, every input reaches the final state through the same transition operator, ∂x_T/∂w_t = Φ(T, t)B_w(t), so systems with the same Lyapunov spectrum can differ arbitrarily in what an agent's own channel, an outside party's channel and noise each reach and at what least energy; and along one unstable direction a larger exponent λ lowers the least effort to reach a displacement, since W_T = b²(e^{2λT} − 1)/2λ grows with λ, while a constant open-loop input against white noise entering the same direction has terminal signal-to-noise ratio tending to (bu/σ)√(2/λ), which falls as λ grows, so only feedback that observes the state turns cheaper control into reliable direction *(Active)*
    - [CLAIM-589](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-589.md) — A motion the constraints permit need not be one the available inputs can drive, and a motion the inputs can drive need not be cheap, reliable or sustainable: permitted directions, actuated directions and transitions achievable at acceptable cost are three objects, the second contained in the first at each instant, while over a horizon what is reachable can exceed what either spans at an instant *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-345
      - [CLAIM-1079](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1079.md) — In the linear tangent–transverse model with a coupling C x∥ in the transverse equation, the deviation from the defining relations is at most ‖C‖X/κ + ‖B⊥‖‖u‖₂/√(2κ), for κ the least restoring rate and X the largest tangential excursion, so strong stabilization leaves tangential adaptation possible only where the demanded move is actuated and affordable and the restoring rate grows with the excursion it must carry *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-345
  - [CLAIM-998](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-998.md) — Effortless action has a direction as well as a timing: the least quadratic effort to move a controlled system by Δx is ΔxᵀW⁻¹Δx with W its controllability Gramian, so a change of given size is cheap along W's strong directions, costly along its weak ones and impossible outside its range, and acting effortlessly is acting along the directions the system already affords, as Cook Ding's knife follows the spaces between the joints *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-541
- [CLAIM-346](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-346.md) — Feasibility, aggregation and epistemic coordination are independent obstructions to an organization's realizing its demands: each can occur with the other two absent *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-668](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-668.md) — A shared record can represent who contributed a proposition and what standing the record gives it, but not what any collaborator believes or that all of them know the current standing: access to the record is a precondition of coordinating on it, not evidence that they have *(Proposed)*
    - [CLAIM-1213](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1213.md) — Just show your work is also a proposal for educators: students will use LLMs anyway, and a record of the collaboration that keeps which contributions were the student's and which the LLM's lets them use LLMs while their own contribution stays assessable *(Proposed)*
      - [CLAIM-1299](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1299.md) — A collaboration record's attributions are only as reliable as the step that makes them: this record attributes each contribution by quotation checked against a verbatim transcript the filer did not write, and a record kept by the student alone, with no such transcript, is self-report that leaves an adopted LLM proposal indistinguishable from the student's own *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-668
      - [CLAIM-1314](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1314.md) — A record of a student's collaboration with an LLM is not proof of understanding but a better basis for questioning it: who first proposed a step, how it was evaluated and whether it was adopted are different pieces of information, and the submission becomes a view over a learning process *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-668
- [CLAIM-350](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-350.md) — A coarse-graining preserves a deterministic judgment exactly when the judgment is constant on its fibres: the judgment then factors through the coarse description, uniquely on its image, and otherwise two states the judgment tells apart have been merged *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-407](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-407.md) — A coarse-graining exactly informationally closed under a process's ordinary dynamics need not preserve its responses to an intervention on the mechanism: for a declared intervention distribution ρ, independent of the state, the deficiency Γ = I(S; Y^(I) | T(S), I) can be positive, as in the hidden governance bit, where it is ρ(h = 1) bits; and Γ = 0 exactly when, for every intervention ρ charges, the response kernels are constant on T's fibres over the states of positive probability *(Active)*
    - [CLAIM-399](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-399.md) — Causal abstraction in the senses of Rubenstein et al., Beckers and Halpern, and Beckers, Eberhardt and Halpern does not secure governance-response sufficiency: exact transformation, τ-abstraction and zero approximate-abstraction distance all accept the hidden-bit coarse-graining, which loses ρ(h = 1) bits of the response to h, because each lets high-level noise carry what the coarse state drops; for one outcome and the identity correspondence, sufficiency is their compatibility condition with the high-level context fixed to the coarse state, and strong abstraction rejects the case only through interventions on the hidden parameter *(Active)*
    - [CLAIM-409](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-409.md) — For one state law, one intervention distribution and one outcome, a deficiency of sufficiency cannot increase under refinement: if T₁ = g∘T₂ then Γ(T₂) ≤ Γ(T₁); informational closure, by contrast, is monotone in neither direction, since in the three-bit chain of Rosas et al. (2024) A is closed, its refinement (A, B) is not and the full state refining that is closed again, while A⊕B, a coarsening of (A, B), is not closed either; closure fails to be monotone because refining a description changes the future it must predict as well as the evidence, so Blackwell dominance, which every deterministic refinement has over its coarsening, does not order closure *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-535](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-535.md) — An organization that acts on what it observes has a policy acceptable in every circumstance exactly when, for each observation, the circumstances it cannot tell apart share an acceptable action; so every circumstance having an acceptable action does not give a policy, a finer observation never removes one, and where acceptable actions overlap the coarsest observations that suffice are several and incomparable, so which distinctions must be made legible depends on which acceptable action the organization commits to *(Active)*
