    - [CLAIM-1323](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1323.md) — A record used to evaluate research should make legible the distinctions the evaluating decision needs and not every detail: publication count is adequate to a question about throughput and inadequate to one about contribution to knowledge *(Proposed)*
      - [CLAIM-1325](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1325.md) — Two evaluators of one research record facing the same decision can need incomparable views of it: the coarsest observations sufficient for a decision can be several and incomparable, so which view suffices depends on which acceptable action an evaluator commits to and not on the decision alone *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-535
    - [CLAIM-622](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-622.md) — Two organizations facing the same circumstances with the same acceptable actions can each be minimally adequate while telling apart different and incomparable sets of circumstances, so a difference in the distinctions two perspectives draw is not by itself evidence that either is deficient; which is deficient can be judged only against the policy each commits to *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-364](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-364.md) — Processes conditioned never to object coordinate without override at the same behaviour and supervisory cost as processes that negotiate, so the two part only under intervention, when a constituent dissents, or in their history *(Proposed)*
  - [CLAIM-1248](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1248.md) — Conditioned and negotiated coordination share their maintenance provenance, since both persist when the supervisor is removed, so the interventions that part them test how the constituents' own processes answer dissent, not whose process keeps the arrangement, and removing the supervisor fails to discriminate because it is the one maintenance-provenance test among them *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-365](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-365.md) — On a norm-ball update set the local frustration residual Φ_r = min over ‖d‖ ≤ r of max_i(ε_i + g_iᵀd) equals the maximum over the simplex of Σλ_iε_i − r‖Σλ_ig_i‖_*, so infeasibility of the declared improvements has a certificate, and any admissible actual update exceeds Φ_r by a nonnegative governance regret *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-629](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-629.md) — Whether several objectives share a strict first-order descent direction is constant on the orbits of any function-preserving symmetry that acts on the parameters as a diffeomorphism, so permutation, positive rescaling across a ReLU and orthogonal maps of a residual stream all leave the verdict unchanged; a frustration residual budgeted in a fixed Euclidean norm is constant on every orbit of such a symmetry whose derivative is orthogonal, so across permutations and orthogonal maps, and not in general otherwise: it can change along rescalings *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-366
- [CLAIM-366](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-366.md) — Whether several objectives share a strict first-order descent direction, 0 ∉ conv{g_i}, is invariant under smooth invertible reparameterization, while the sign of a Euclidean gradient inner product is not, and a negative inner product does not exclude common descent; a budgeted version is invariant only with the metric pulled back *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-369](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-369.md) — In symmetric resource-mediated competition with interaction matrix A = UᵀU and growth rates r = Uᵀb − c, Lotka–Volterra population dynamics are multiplicative gradient flow on the convex feature-selection objective ½‖b − Un‖² + cᵀn over the nonnegative orthant: the invasion fitness of an absent component is the negative partial derivative of that objective, and the uninvadable equilibria are its KKT points *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-1181](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1181.md) — In the symmetric resource-competition class that MacArthur's consumer-resource model reduces to, Chesson's niche overlap is the cosine of two components' niche vectors, his average fitness is a component's net marginal value at zero abundance per unit niche norm, and a rare component's growth against a lone resident is its niche norm times its fitness less the overlap times the resident's *(Active)* — through [ARG-236](../record/arguments.d/ARG-236.md)
  - [CLAIM-885](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-885.md) — In symmetric resource competition whose operators adapt a bounded niche trait up the selection gradient, a differentiated equilibrium is locally exponentially stable when its traits are interior and stationary or held at a bound with an outward gradient and the Hessian of the shared objective on the free coordinates is positive definite; every specialist then recovers when rare against residents whose traits are frozen, at a rate of at least its abundance times its niche vector's squared distance from the span of the others' *(Proposed)*
    - [CLAIM-886](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-886.md) — Symmetric competition with bounded niche adaptation does not secure recovery against residents that re-adapt: in a two-resource trade-off, a stable pair of specialists, each recovering when rare against a frozen partner, coexists with a stable lone generalist against which a removed specialist has negative growth, and a lone specialist leaves its corner for the vacated niche when c/B < a'(0)/a'(1) *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-371](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-371.md) — Under the componentwise order on distortion profiles, two profiles are incomparable exactly when they trade off, and then positive weightings can rank them either way, while every positive weighting agrees with a dominance *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-380](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-380.md) — With finitely many states and finitely many outcomes, the positive part of the Bayes-risk increase on the same decision problem is directed, is zero from a garbling back to its source, vanishes for every finite problem and prior exactly when the rendering is at least as informative as the source, and has A86's D_Q as its symmetrization *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-326](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-326.md) — With losses in [0, 1] and a stated prior, the positive part of the Bayes-risk increase on the same decision problem, D⁺_Q(U → V; π), is directed, is zero from a garbling back to its source, vanishes for every finite problem and prior exactly when the rendering is at least as informative as the source in Blackwell's order, over finitely many states and a source whose outcome space is standard Borel, and has A86's D_Q, with the identity on tasks, as its symmetrization *(Active)*
    - [CLAIM-259](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-259.md) — For report fidelity, the decision term should be the positive part of the risk increase on the same decision problem, with losses in [0, 1] and a stated prior; so restated it is directed, counts no improvement as loss, and vanishes for every problem and prior exactly when the rendering is at least as informative as the source in Blackwell's order *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-380
    - [CLAIM-636](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-636.md) — Where a literal rendering loses nothing the source offers on the declared report problems, no rendering made from the source without the situation, a compensating one included, is a better report for an ideal receiver, so compensation serves report fidelity only as a gain in a code-bound reader's usable information, or where the literal rendering itself loses a distinction the reports concern *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-199
- [CLAIM-385](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-385.md) — If a symmetric operator on ℝⁿ commutes with an orthogonal representation of a compact group, each eigenspace is a sum of real irreducibles and each multiplicity a sum of multiples of their dimensions, so SO(2) and ℤ/n for n ≥ 3 force paired eigenvalues; conversely the spectrum fixes neither the group nor a basis inside an eigenspace *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-386](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-386.md) — For x(t+1) = (A* + εC)x with A* block-diagonal, the Simon–Ando aggregate Â = QAV has one-step closure defect exactly QA − ÂQ = QA(I − VQ); the part from the blocks' own dynamics vanishes iff every block has equal column sums, and then the whole defect is ε·QC(I − VQ) *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-526](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-526.md) — Describing persons and organizations as coexisting levels of one process removes the question of how already-constituted agents add up to a collective, but not the question of levels: whether a collective variable has dynamics of its own, closed against the activity that realizes it, can be decided on a process description that presupposes no agents, is sometimes decided no, and a closed collective variable can be an aggregate that coexists with its realization while keeping none of its members' distinctions *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-388, CLAIM-480
- [CLAIM-388](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-388.md) — Exact dynamical closure of a collective variable does not require a nearly decomposable block: in a linear Gaussian VAR(1) with uniform coupling among n units, the sum of all units is exactly dynamically independent at every stable coupling strength, while every partition of the units into two or more groups couples as strongly across its edges as within them *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-397](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-397.md) — For a scalar stationary process with autocovariance C, the Mori–Zwanzig memory kernels for the projection onto the current value are fixed by C alone, through C(m+1) = Σ_{k≤m} c_k C(m−k); the memory vanishes iff C is geometric, and when C has finite Hankel rank d the memory has Hankel rank exactly d − 1 *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-414](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-414.md) — Matched ordinary trajectories can conceal differences in an interpretation's efficacy, in the allocation of that efficacy, and in the maintenance of its enabling constraints: in two finite constructions, systems that agree under ordinary operation differ in each, and a specified intervention exposes the difference that passive observation of the matched trajectories does not *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-417](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-417.md) — What the record explained by "self" in its dispositional, persisting, self-governing and integrated senses is better explained by organizational perspectives, with a perspective, its carriers, its lineage and its representations kept apart; the subject sense stays a separate question, and narrative, presented and modeled selves involve representations that may describe a perspective, attribute it to a bearer or construct an owner, none of them the perspective itself *(Proposed)* — through [ARG-025](../record/arguments.d/ARG-025.md)
  - [CLAIM-427](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-427.md) — Evidence for the organizational-perspective framework comes in three grades: that different organizations produce the same ordinary behaviour, that they respond differently to independently specified interventions, and that a model representing the coupling of significance, authority and reproduction predicts those responses better than the strongest existing alternatives at matched complexity; only the third bears on the framework's defeater, and no grade counts if success is defined in the framework's own terms *(Superseded)*
  - [CLAIM-519](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-519.md) — Competent behaviour does not establish an internal world model: over a fixed interface and a finite horizon, an agent with no model, whose actions are looked up from the history so far, reproduces the interaction distribution of an agent that has one exactly; a policy can identify predictive structure without any particular internal component realizing it, so compression and generalization support comparing candidate architectures, and establishing an internal mechanism needs evidence that discriminates candidate implementations, such as targeted interventions *(Proposed)*
    - [CLAIM-514](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-514.md) — World-modeling is a family of resource-bounded capabilities for producing and using predictions about an environment's possibilities and consequences, each relative to a declared family of questions; a world model in the representational sense is one possible realization of them, competent behaviour can determine environmental structure without identifying any internal mechanism, and producing, maintaining and revising world-modeling capabilities are further achievements, not prerequisites of agency in general *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-513
    - [CLAIM-765](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-765.md) — Two properties of what a learner retains come apart in all four combinations: identifiability, whether a retained change and its contribution can be established from observation and intervention, and localization, whether it sits in a place one can point to *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-135
  - [CLAIM-540](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-540.md) — The persistence a Dirichlet–categorical hierarchy gives a run of selections is an observer's learning about a fixed mixture, not a change in what selects: under a uniform prior an observed first choice raises the predicted chance of repeating it from 1/2 to 2/3, while the same choice forced leaves it at 1/2, so the hierarchy's reinforcement is not evidence of self-formation or of a maintained will-organization, which need the mixture itself to change under the choice *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-649](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-649.md) — An absence of response under an inserted intervention with an expected response profile is diagnostic evidence about the mechanism under test, carried with nothing emitted: under a probabilistic response model it shifts support toward fault by its likelihood ratio, and in the limiting case of a deterministic, independently validated response guarantee it entails that the guarantee was violated *(Proposed)* — through [ARG-085](../record/arguments.d/ARG-085.md)
    - [CLAIM-648](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-648.md) — On Bickhard's account the owner's debugging case has an endogenous form: a self-maintaining system that anticipates an interaction will sustain it holds an expected response profile set by its own upkeep, the absence or shortfall of the response means by its own lights that the interaction failed, and that norm and a designer's profile come apart where the system's persistence is at stake *(Proposed)* — through [ARG-083](../record/arguments.d/ARG-083.md)
- [CLAIM-415](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-415.md) — A person can be organized by a judgement they attribute to a collective that does not hold it: the audience in a self-model can be a false unity, and a judgement can shape a person who rejects it, because resisting it makes it consequential *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-416](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-416.md) — Competing perspectives compete over the tests that measure them as well as under them: success under an evaluative regime is evidence of competence relative to that regime, a fair test need not be neutral across competences, and a perspective that gains influence over the test can change what later success shows *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-418](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-418.md) — Possessing, enacting or being shaped by an organizational perspective does not establish an independent agent, and perspectival, agential and institutional boundaries need not coincide: several agents can share a perspective, one agent can act through several, and a perspective can be reproduced with no agent governing it; where a perspective contributes to an agent's activity it can enable and constrain the exercise of agency, and that exercise can reproduce or transform it, while whether agency universally requires such a perspective stays open *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-1019](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1019.md) — Self-like organizational unity does not require perspectival singularity: a historically sustained, causally integrated plurality of perspectives may suffice for some of what is attributed to a self with no unique overarching perspective, since integration does not entail organizational singularity, nor organizational singularity phenomenal singularity *(Proposed)*
  - [CLAIM-1039](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1039.md) — A team's members are necessarily separable as carriers, but its perspectives need not be: one perspective can span members and one member can realize several, and in a model where each member's perspective is a distribution over a shared interpretive space, the members' carrier-tagged measures are always mutually singular while the measures they project to can coincide *(Proposed)*
  - [CLAIM-1048](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1048.md) — A stronger candidate for a pseudo-self than a crowd answering questions or an ensemble run by an external controller is an organization with historically maintained integration, differentiated inquiry, consequential governance, reflexive revisability and adaptive viability *(Proposed)*
  - [CLAIM-1128](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1128.md) — What a team's separable members supply is separable sites of intervention, not separable units of perspective: they make a team an experimental model of self-like organization, since members can be questioned, given evidence, denied access, replaced or removed one at a time, while the team's own dispositions may depend on relations among them that no member's isolated profile records *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-431](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-431.md) — A corporation's functional remorse cannot be told from prudence: any procedure or role duty that makes others' harms its concern was put there for its own ends, reputation, liability or recruitment, so the line between harm as concern and harm as threat, and with it the line between a remorseful and a psychopathic corporation, does not hold, and the clinical word adds nothing to a description of its incentives *(Proposed)*
    - [CLAIM-1252](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1252.md) — To have standing toward an agent is to have claims that can constrain what it is entitled to optimize, not only to enter its objective, so an organizational objective that admits other parties only through their contribution to it excludes their standing whatever it knows of them, and a specialized objective such as shareholder value is legitimate only so far as the outside governance it relies on to supply those constraints is adequate *(Proposed)* — through [ARG-243](../record/arguments.d/ARG-243.md) — also argued from CLAIM-1169
  - [CLAIM-960](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-960.md) — For a whole that is a bare relational arrangement, being a constituent adds no obligation beyond those grounded in the constituent's vulnerability, interests, rights and exposure to power: the part-whole relation locates where an obligation applies without grounding it, and because such an arrangement is not an agent the obligation falls on the agents or roles that maintain, control or benefit from it, not on the whole *(Proposed)* — through [ARG-207](../record/arguments.d/ARG-207.md)
- [CLAIM-419](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-419.md) — The record's grammar is fixed at any moment but amendable by decision, and in practice a move that fit no scheme or relation has repeatedly been treated as a defect of the grammar and answered by amending it, so a move the grammar cannot hold is not only forced or lost; whether every such move is caught is not shown *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-469](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-469.md) — Luria is an apparatus for a record's objects in the operational sense: through its schemes, vocabularies, validators and generated views it realizes a system of distinctions that fixes what counts as a referable and governable object within the record, so that a split scheme makes one object two and a promoted vocabulary makes a value an entity; it keeps, enforces and propagates those distinctions; and its distinctions are revised through the record's own use *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-479
    - [CLAIM-1159](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1159.md) — A team's historically sustained organization of differing perspectives can be partly realized in a shared governed record: the record keeps which distinctions persist, which contributions become consequential and which changes oblige revision, so the organization of the collaborators and the record, not the record alone, may be the bearer of a collective perspective, and the record becomes adaptively significant when the collaborators' differences can revise its own distinctions *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-418
    - [CLAIM-1215](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1215.md) — A publishing system is part of the apparatus of inquiry: its representation of scholarly work fixes which kinds of labour are recognizable as contributions, so changing the representation changes what counts, and a system that is to stay adequate must govern revisions of its own rules of representation and evaluation as well as of the claims it holds *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-419
- [CLAIM-420](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-420.md) — A historical figure's influence can persist in three separable ways, as a story about them, as a perspective transmitted from them, and as later organizations that descend from their activity, and causal descent is not perspectival inheritance: a movement founded to oppose someone can descend from them without continuing their perspective *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-421](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-421.md) — The cessation of an organizational perspective's enactment need not imply the loss of the dispositions, capacities or reproductive relationships from which it can be reinstated: an interruption can be of activation (the disposition is held but not engaged or retrievable), of enactment (held, but the material, institutional or social conditions for exercising it are gone) or of reproduction (held by some bearers, but the processes that pass it on are damaged), and temporary unavailability is not extinction, though prolonged interruption of reproduction can end a tradition *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-434](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-434.md) — On a finite set of outcomes, some function rises with every move that wins one of a negotiation's conflicts exactly when no chain of winning moves returns to where it began, and the length of the longest such chain ending at an outcome is one such function; a perfectly transitive record of which side won each pair, in a complete tournament contesting every pair once, leaves a cyclic share of (n − 2)/3n under the Hodge decomposition, a baseline that does not carry to sparse records; the Hodge gradient can reverse a comparison the wins settle, netting a record erases alternation, a record fixes a class of potentials rather than one, a coherent record is not yet one aligned with any single perspective's ordering, a best-fitting ordering of a cycle is no Lyapunov function, the sign a class of potentials gives can be set-valued, and an ordering fitted to a record overstates its agreement there *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-451](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-451.md) — When an organization's record of winning moves cycles, the failure is organizational nonintegrability, distinct from a perspective's own preference instability and from switching of the governing regime; it becomes organizational tension only when realized as costly reversal against demands the organization maintains, and cognitive dissonance only when that tension is detected and appraised as aversive; learning can relieve it by accommodation, by entrenched precedence or by cheap periodic coordination, which observed coherence does not tell apart, and ambivalence and nonintegrability entail neither one another *(Proposed)*
  - [CLAIM-482](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-482.md) — An organization's aggregate revealed preference exists exactly when its record of winning moves never cycles, and where it exists it is fitted to one regime of authority, so an intervention on authority that changes the winning moves changes the fitted preference and the preference does not predict the change *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-436](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-436.md) — An instantaneous ordering is a common currency on a finite set of options, where every complete preorder has a real-valued representation, but not in general: the lexicographic order on the unit square has no real-valued representation, while a continuous complete preorder on a connected separable space has a continuous one; so admitting an ordering is strictly weaker than admitting a currency, a graded lexicographic override lies in the gap while an exact threshold override does not, a threshold override with a discrimination threshold is a lexicographic semiorder whose choices can cycle and so is no ordering at all, and even where each instant has a currency, successive currencies need not share exchange rates *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-455](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-455.md) — For one bounded observer, a transformation of a representation can make one task's distinction legible and another's illegible at once, so legibility regimes are ordered only relative to a task, and a regime that improves one perspective's competence can disable another's *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-463](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-463.md) — Restoring the conditions under which a capacity was lost need not restore the capacity: where the activity that maintains it reinforces itself, the same conditions can sustain both the capacity and its absence, so a capacity lost past a threshold returns only under conditions better than those it was lost under, or by rebuilding the activity directly, and restoring it can cost more than preserving it would have *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-1272](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1272.md) — Beside insufficient adjustment and selective accessibility, an anchor may act by nucleation, helping a new response organization form that then maintains itself, so its influence outlasts the anchor; the mechanisms part on what follows the anchor's removal, influence that declines with further adjustment against persistence, hysteresis or transfer, and the same contrast separates a transient framing effect from a durable change of perspective *(Proposed)*
  - [CLAIM-1310](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1310.md) — In the seeded fold model, a transient seed leaves a maintained organization only inside the bistable window and only by carrying the state past the unstable threshold, a brief seed needing exactly that threshold and a slower one more; the meme enters only as a scalar forcing, so the model expresses the environment's receptivity but not which organization a seed nucleates *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-464](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-464.md) — An intervention can change what it would take to correct it: by altering the distribution of control, access, resources or enforcement before it is reviewed, it can make a specified corrective outcome costlier or unreachable while the standards that govern that outcome stay the same *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-701](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-701.md) — An actor that wrongfully creates circumstances in which reversing its act would harm innocent third parties can give a reviewing institution genuine reasons to accommodate those harms, as moral blackmail gives its target a genuine obligation; the reviewer's sound weighing of those reasons does not discharge the actor's responsibility for having wrongfully created them, and the reasons are no larger than the circumstances support *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-703
  - [CLAIM-722](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-722.md) — Succeeding in making a remedy unreachable gains a wrongdoer no normative power over what is owed: a claim still valid under the standard persists while the correctability of its fitting remedy falls to zero, and an acceptance or settlement reached under the conditions the violation created does not by that fact authorize the violation *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-470](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-470.md) — Inquiry is a form of specification: a question fixes which differences would count as an answer, an inquiry adds the operations that make those differences accessible, and what it finds can stabilize into a specification that constrains later inquiry; so inquiry stands to its findings as a specification to its realizations, with one difference, that an inquiry can revise what an answer could be *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-1012](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1012.md) — Practical questions put to an organization can be modelled as queries met by realizations, and their relation as a robust interrogation game in which a respondent chooses a response policy against the strongest permitted queries; the game has diagnostic, adversarial and developmental forms that are not interchangeable, so maximizing the difficulty of queries is not good governance and the query side needs justified constraints *(Proposed)*
    - [CLAIM-1032](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1032.md) — In the robust interrogation game the worst query distribution against any fixed response policy is a single query, and when each query can be answered on its own the game reduces to the worst query's best response; it is a game, with a mixed query strategy at equilibrium, only when one prepared policy must serve several queries through shared state or resources, or when the permitted query distributions are restricted *(Proposed)* — through [ARG-230](../record/arguments.d/ARG-230.md)
  - [CLAIM-1031](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1031.md) — The organization of possibility can be treated as a game between queries and targets, between what can be asked of an organization and what it can answer *(Proposed)*
  - [CLAIM-475](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-475.md) — Specifying is itself a resource-bounded realization: formulating a question takes time, concepts and computation as realizing a configuration takes energy and matter, so the questions an agent can ask are a product of what it has already realized; a stabilized specification is past inquiry stored so that later questions become cheaper to ask, and it can make other questions harder *(Active)*
    - [CLAIM-1003](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1003.md) — An organization can lose adaptability by two routes, becoming less able to answer new questions or its institutions becoming less able to ask them; the second is harder to detect, since a question nobody formulates leaves no recorded failure to answer it, so an ecosystem can grow better at its established questions while becoming less able to answer unfamiliar ones and to discover which of them matter *(Proposed)*
      - [CLAIM-1188](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1188.md) — Regulation governs the evolving relationship between the demands an industrial ecology can recognize and formulate and the responses it can organize, realize and maintain, so adaptive governance is the viable co-development of inquiry and response capacities, without the evaluation that joins them becoming self-confirming *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-1053
    - [CLAIM-1065](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1065.md) — Asking permission is resource bounded, and its boundedness connects the record's account of inquiry under deadlines directly to its legibility program *(Proposed)*
    - [CLAIM-1157](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1157.md) — That asking and answering are each resource-bounded does not make them compete: a common budget, a common bottleneck or a sequential dependence supplies the coupling, and a shared deadline is not a shared pool of worker-hours, since independent processes can spend the same elapsed time at once *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-1114
      - [CLAIM-1008](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1008.md) — Where inquiry of depth k must finish before execution can start within a deadline H, the chance of success p(k)F(H − t(k)) is greatest at an interior depth where the relative gain in finding a suitable response equals the time cost times the relative loss in execution readiness, so the appropriate depth of inquiry depends on the deadline and on the target's response dynamics *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-475
        - [CLAIM-1203](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1203.md) — In the sequential model of inquiry depth the best depth never falls as the deadline lengthens when execution readiness is log-concave in the time left, but when execution takes either a fast or a slow route a longer deadline can make a much shallower inquiry best, because the time it saves buys the slow route *(Active)*
    - [CLAIM-761](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-761.md) — A stabilized constraint can be stored work: by replacing later work with cheaper operations it changes which activities are realizable within a fixed per-task budget, so amortization becomes capability expansion without any added degrees of freedom or resources; the expansion is conditional on the costs of constructing, keeping, retrieving, verifying and revising the constraint and on the distribution of later demands, and the persistence that buys it can entrench *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-303, CLAIM-582
      - [CLAIM-1060](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1060.md) — Organizational governance is partly the intertemporal allocation of scarce resources among inquiry, response and the upkeep of the structures that make both possible, slow organizational modes arise partly as ways of amortizing inquiry and coordination costs, and adaptive governance must keep the capacity to reallocate between answering existing questions and learning to ask and answer new ones *(Proposed)* — through [ARG-238](../record/arguments.d/ARG-238.md) — also rests on CLAIM-475; also argued from CLAIM-475
      - [CLAIM-1319](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1319.md) — Invoking a relationship differs from reusing a stored result in that the invocation can change the relationship it invokes, so one operation can reproduce, form or transform a contract, and a stored-work cost model that holds the store fixed between uses prices a contract's lifecycle but not its invocation, which returns an act, a distribution of costs over the parties and the relationship's next state *(Proposed)* — through [ARG-246](../record/arguments.d/ARG-246.md) — also rests on CLAIM-1156, CLAIM-569; also argued from CLAIM-569
      - [CLAIM-891](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-891.md) — One cost model prices a crew's speed bugs, a filed argument and a LEGO bin with the same terms, once work is priced by the moment it is done and checked against the budget for each demand, not only summed; what carries each differs: the bugs are paid by moving work to a quieter moment or by fitting a busy one, more than by reuse, the filed argument by how forecastable its reuse is, how often it goes stale and what recognizing it costs in a growing store, and the bin by the search it replaces against a deadline, at a construction made nearly free by doing it when the brick is found *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-303, CLAIM-307, CLAIM-760
    - [CLAIM-794](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-794.md) — In a record of inquiry that amends its grammar when a move fits nothing, refining a category makes misfits in the refined region more noticeable rather than fewer: a move the coarse category would have absorbed without residue now visibly fits none of the finer ones, so a refinement exposes misfits as well as absorbing them *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-419, CLAIM-470
    - [CLAIM-996](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-996.md) — Permission to pursue an inquiry is a second-order query, formulated by the proponent and evaluated by the authority within their own budgets, so the questions an organization authorizes are a subset of those its members can ask, and an authorization can take so long that the opportunity it authorizes has closed, whatever the verdict *(Proposed)*
      - [CLAIM-1117](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1117.md) — The cost of making a proposal legible to the authority that controls its resources is not a property of the idea but of how an institution distributes interpretive labour, so an institution can steer which questions are pursued by deciding who must pay to make them legible, with no rule against any idea *(Proposed)*
        - [CLAIM-1132](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1132.md) — An organization's possibility space is shaped not only by what its members know how to do but by what they can afford to make intelligible to those empowered to let them do it, so adaptive governance needs maintained pathways by which locally intelligible inquiry acquires evidence, resources and authority *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-1119, CLAIM-1140, CLAIM-996
      - [CLAIM-1119](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1119.md) — Maintained alternative perspectives are alternative legibility regimes: each lowers the cost of making some kinds of question intelligible and testable within it, so with protected resources and a route to wider uptake one can develop an inquiry until its results are legible elsewhere, and keeping a perspective able to do this means keeping its practices, expertise, channels and capacity for work, not only an archive of its ideas *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-455
      - [CLAIM-1140](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1140.md) — Where the evidence that would justify authorizing an inquiry can only be produced with resources that need the authorization, the dependency is circular, so a proposal's failure to persuade does not show that the possibility behind it is worthless *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-277
        - [CLAIM-1016](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1016.md) — Authorization granted question by question puts its cost between formulating a question and investigating it, on the same budget, while a standing grant pays it once for a domain before any question in it is formulated, so the remedies for the circle between evidence and permission work by changing the unit of authorization, and authorization's cost belongs in the joint inquiry relation as a third cost on the shared budget *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-996
  - [CLAIM-786](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-786.md) — Building something is a method of inquiring into it: an artifact made to a specification drawn from a theory tests that theory, and its failures to behave as specified are findings about the theory, not only about the artifact; the record itself, built to study how an argument develops, is inquiry by this method *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-479](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-479.md) — In the record a typed relation is more constrained than either of its relata: a claim's content is open prose, while `rests_on` fixes the scheme at both ends, has `supports` written as its converse and says what retiring its target leaves, and none of that moves when either claim's content does; so a relation's rigidity is a fact about the grammar, not evidence that the dependency it records is sound *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-480](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-480.md) — Composing interactions can turn an interior into a constraint, and sometimes into a constraint of a new kind: in the chain E = ½k₁(x₁ − x₂)² + ½k₂(x₂ − x₃)², with x₂ internal and equilibrated, the boundary sees E_eff = ½·k₁k₂/(k₁ + k₂)·(x₁ − x₃)², a coupling between x₁ and x₃ that neither part has; if the interior relaxes slowly, eliminating it leaves a history-dependent constraint, a memory kernel, so interconnection fixes an effective constraint on the boundary's trajectories and separation of time scales decides only whether that constraint is approximately memoryless; and for cellular sheaves the reduced constraint can relate three boundary values where every relation among the parts is pairwise *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-471](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-471.md) — Physical interconnection can generate effective constraints on joint behaviour; measurement can estimate correspondences among local descriptions; and adaptive apparatuses can revise those correspondences; gluing expresses compatibility under specified relations, but neither the relations' physical generation nor their adequacy follows from gluing alone *(Active)*
    - [CLAIM-473](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-473.md) — Coupling locally described systems necessarily induces a separation of time scales between their collective behaviour and their relative behaviour *(Rejected)*
    - [CLAIM-474](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-474.md) — From interconnection to individuation, the relationships are distinct achievements that form a partial order, not a nested sequence: none implies the next, and a later one need not require every earlier one. Interconnection fixes what joint behaviour is possible, compatibility which local descriptions admit a coherent whole, dynamics which organizations persist, individuation which have sufficiently robust identity and boundaries, organizational autonomy which help maintain their own constitutive constraints, and inquiry which can measure and revise their own models and apparatuses under resource bounds, inquiry and reconstruction occurring without autonomy. The research program is to find the conditions for each, and their dependencies, apart from the order in which an inquiry meets them *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-470, CLAIM-475, CLAIM-480, CLAIM-481
  - [CLAIM-528](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-528.md) — That a mechanism realizes a capacity can mean that the capacity is produced through it over time or that the capacity consists in it at a time, and interventions show only the first: a pathway whose disabling changes the capacity after a delay is a cause, can be intervened on surgically, and can be located relative to a declared boundary, whereas every intervention on a capacity that consists in its parts also changes some part along another path, so that relation is underdetermined by intervention data and is inferred by abduction or from simultaneity and settled parthood; and which of the two a given dependence is depends on the time resolution at which a description treats the parts' response as instantaneous *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-481](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-481.md) — Coupling does not by itself separate time scales: two identical undamped oscillators coupled with stiffness k have normal modes at ω₀ and √(ω₀² + 2k), nearly equal when k ≪ ω₀², and neither decays; separation comes where the coupling dissipates relative differences faster than collective ones, as in ẋ = −ax − k(x − y), ẏ = −ay − k(y − x), whose collective and relative modes relax at rates a and a + 2k, and in a Laplacian flow ẋ = −κLx, where the spectrum of L sets the rates *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-640](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-640.md) — Where viable regimes exchange symmetrically and fail into an absorbing state at small hazards, the survivors settle at the spectral gap of the exchange among the viable regimes to within the largest hazard, so the separation between settling and dying out is a dissipative coupling's, and it depends on how the regimes are connected: for regimes in a line it shrinks as their number grows, and for regimes all connected it grows *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-612
- [CLAIM-486](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-486.md) — A rendering can keep the communicative act while changing the proposition, so preserving the proposition is not necessary for preserving the communicative event *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-502](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-502.md) — Multi-hop delegation can keep an operator's authority exactly independent of its own grants: under leave-one-out damped delegation, which counts the authority reaching each operator only along paths that have not already passed through it, an operator's grants raise the authority of every operator its grantee reaches and leave its own unchanged *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-513](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-513.md) — Across a family of goals, a world model is not an optional explanation of competent behaviour: in a fully observed, finite, communicating, stationary environment, a goal-conditioned policy within a factor 1 − δ of optimal on every composite goal of depth n fixes every transition probability to within √(2P(1 − P)/((n − 1)(1 − δ))), so observers reading the same policy must ascribe the same world model; what it leaves open is whether a predictive component is realized inside the agent, since a lookup table over histories and goals has the same policy *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-520](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-520.md) — The value of keeping a corrective capacity is conditional on objectives, uncertainty and cost: a free, optional audit cannot lower a single time-consistent decision-maker's expected performance, but an audit that costs C to maintain and bears on k decisions with error rate ε is worth k(0.25 − 0.5ε) − C in the exchange's model, negative when C is large or k small, and where no hypothesis fits the world, correction gains no reward and improves only calibration *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-522](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-522.md) — Recovery under interventions on state cannot show where maintenance is realized: an outside controller that measures the constraint capacities and supplies the internal production law as state feedback yields the same trajectory under every perturbation of state, damage and recovery included, even with every capacity observed exactly; only interventions on the production mechanisms, relative to a declared boundary, separate the two *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-530](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-530.md) — Where maintenance is realized is a question of constitutive relevance only through its parthood condition: an internal producer and an outside controller supplying the same production law as state feedback meet mutual manipulability's two manipulability conditions identically, since disabling or stimulating either changes the maintained capacities and intervening on the capacities changes the activity of either, so what puts one inside and the other outside is parthood, a boundary the experiments presuppose and do not find *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-523](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-523.md) — For a normatively relevant discrepancy to change what an organization does, three distinct achievements are needed and any can fail while the others hold: legibility, by which the discrepancy becomes recognizable; volitional efficacy, by which a corresponding demand can move action; and correctability, by which a fitting revision can be carried out within deadline and resources; none establishes that the demand or the revision is justified, and whether the norm-satisfying histories the agent can still realize are empty depends partly on what its earlier actions destroyed *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-1249](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1249.md) — Manufactured doubt can work on the threshold of evidence for action rather than on belief: an organization of interpretation in which residual uncertainty outweighs accumulated evidence defers action while the evidence is still recognized, and can outlast the campaign that seeded it *(Proposed)*
  - [CLAIM-686](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-686.md) — Where a dependent party's claims on an arrangement's controllers fail of legibility, volitional efficacy or correctability in the controlling organization, the dependent lacks effective means of influence and challenge, and where they fail so at every party able to constrain the controllers it lacks effective protection; justified withdrawal lies outside those three achievements, so the domination threshold's third condition is met by failures of normative efficacy only together with a failure of exit, and is not those failures restated *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-732](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-732.md) — A protected objection is effective only if six achievements hold together, its becoming formulable, legible, taken up by an authorized channel, sustainable by the objector, corrected and maintained, so an objection can fail at any of them while its formal standing is unchanged, its chance of success is no greater than that of its weakest stage, and a reform that raises one stage's success can lower the whole *(Proposed)*
  - [CLAIM-740](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-740.md) — For a party affected by a decision, explanation (understanding why it was reached), contestation (challenging it or the principles behind it) and interruption (suspending its execution while the challenge is considered) are separate entitlements, and each without the next fails in its own way: explanation without contestation is transparency without accountability, contestation without interruption a right that arrives too late, and interruption without reasons an arbitrary veto *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-541](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-541.md) — Wu-wei is better read as control placed and timed where a system's own dynamics do most of the work than as the absence of control: Ott–Grebogi–Yorke control of chaos is a formal instance, in which small perturbations timed by the system's own wandering hold it on an unstable orbit, and the control, though small, continues for as long as the orbit is held; so reported effortlessness has at least three distinct sources, no conflict to override, conflict settled cheaply by learned accommodation, and conflict met as it arises by small well-timed feedback, which may feel alike and differ in mechanism *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-563](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-563.md) — When process costs compose by a monotone operation, the processes costing at most b are closed under composition whenever b composed with itself is at most b, and not otherwise once two composable processes each cost b: at every budget for a peak capacity composed by maximum, and for a cumulative expenditure composed by sum only at budgets 0 and infinity *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-581](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-581.md) — Under peak-capacity costs on reversible moves, the transition threshold between configurations is an extended pseudo-ultrametric, so identifying configurations reachable within a budget is an equivalence relation at every budget and the identifications nest into one tree as the budget grows; under additive costs the threshold is only an extended pseudometric, budgeted identification need not be transitive, and no such tree exists *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-571
    - [CLAIM-780](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-780.md) — For a chain with symmetric rates ε to the power U on a connected graph of n states and E edges, the log commute time between two states lies within log max(E, n − 1) of log n plus log(1/ε) times their minimax barrier, an ultrametric; so after scaling by log(1/ε) the time geometry of the state space converges to that ultrametric, the tree of classes reachable within a budget, and a level of the tree shows in the geometry once the rate ratio across it exceeds max(E, n − 1) squared; that the geometry is hyperbolic with bounded δ is not the content, since the logarithm of any metric is nearly an ultrametric *(Proposed)*
      - [CLAIM-769](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-769.md) — Seen from one of its states, a tree of rate differences relaxes as a power of time, not exponentially, because the escape it sees is an average of exponentials over a spread of rates; hyperbolic discounting is the same kind of average, so a hierarchy of time scales is one origin of hyperbolic-like discounting, though the exact hyperbola needs a particular spread: per-level rates falling by the square of the branching on a uniform tree, or an exponential spread of hazards *(Proposed)*
      - [CLAIM-770](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-770.md) — The tree of classes reachable within a budget, the limit of a chain's time geometry as time scales separate, keeps its shape while barriers move and changes only where two barriers cross: a distinction between levels comes into being or passes away at such a crossing, and near it the two levels cannot be told apart in the time geometry *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-581
  - [CLAIM-590](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-590.md) — Which category is chosen changes which configurations count as the same: in the fundamental groupoid of a degree-4 vertex's configuration space every two configurations are uniquely isomorphic, while in the category enriched in peak footprint under maximum its two folded states are 1.866 apart in each direction and each is 0 from itself, a distance the enriched Yoneda embedding keeps, so equivalence of possibilities is not equivalence of resource-bounded capabilities *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-571
- [CLAIM-566](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-566.md) — That a form assembles, that it persists over a specified horizon and that the system regenerates it after turnover are three properties with separate probabilities, and a structure that assembles and persists without producing the constraints that would regenerate it does not show organizational closure *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-600](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-600.md) — Transient support can be withdrawn safely only if it started a process that keeps itself going on a flux that will stay available, was large enough to carry the supported party past any threshold that process has, outlasted the threat it stood in for, and left the work to the party throughout, in each subtask it must later do alone and not only in its role as a whole, at no more effort than it could bear, and, where the capacity is cumulative and its field moves fast, kept up after withdrawal; inputs the party cannot produce must stay supplied as a standing part of the arrangement; support that fails these leaves dependence or decay, but meeting them all is not enough, since support can carry a function nobody names before withdrawal; and persistence after withdrawal is needed to tell which, though slow reversion can mimic it *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-597, CLAIM-602, CLAIM-604
- [CLAIM-571](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-571.md) — For a fixed architecture and one resource that must be held at each moment, the resource threshold for reaching a target configuration need not equal the resource requirement of the target: it is the least, over admissible transition paths, of the peak requirement along the path, and it is infinite when no admissible path joins the two *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-567](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-567.md) — That a target configuration is feasible, that it is reachable from the start under the admissible transformations, and that the process reliably reaches it are three properties, each implied by the next and none implying it *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-568](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-568.md) — A transition can fail in four ways that call for different remedies: a feasible path exceeds a resource ceiling, no path exists in the fixed configuration space, a path exists that no available input can execute, or a path exists that cannot be reliably followed; added actuation can overcome an energy barrier and cannot join disconnected configurations *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-569](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-569.md) — A form has at least three resource requirements, to construct it, to maintain it, and to move into or out of it, and none fixes another: a capability can be cheap to keep and costly to acquire, so having enough to sustain it is not having enough to acquire it *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-577](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-577.md) — A budget set each period to the peak resource spent the period before never rises, so the configurations an organization can reach shrink monotonically, and any transition whose threshold exceeds the cost of holding the current configuration is lost after one period spent holding it, unless the budget is raised from outside by at least the difference *(Active)*
    - [CLAIM-1093](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1093.md) — Maintaining a reserve and redesigning a transition change different components of readiness, one keeping enough capacity to cross an existing transition barrier and the other lowering the barrier itself, and under a budget that follows peak use they are complementary requirements rather than independently sufficient alternatives, unless the redesigned barrier is no higher than the cost of holding *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-571
    - [CLAIM-1099](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1099.md) — Under a budget set each period to the last period's peak use, a redesigned transition is lost like the original unless its threshold is at most the cost of holding the present configuration, so redesign lowers the reserve a transition needs by the fall in its threshold and replaces the reserve only where it leaves no reconfiguration slack *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-571, CLAIM-679
      - [CLAIM-1180](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1180.md) — With one capacity that can be brought to bear at every configuration, a reserve held at budget B keeps every transition whose threshold is at most B, while a redesign lowers only the thresholds whose least-peak path can use the redesigned route, so a redesign that lets the reserve fall from θ − h to θ′ − h keeps the redesigned transition and loses every other transition the larger reserve kept whose threshold lies above θ′ and whose least-peak path does not use the redesign, that is, those with threshold in (θ′, θ] *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-571, CLAIM-577
    - [CLAIM-878](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-878.md) — Under a budget set each period to the last period's peak spending, a capability stays funded exactly as long as every period occupies capacity at its cost, which a mobilization of it does whether a use, a drill, a false alarm or a cancelled dispatch, so where nothing else occupies that much, dispatching it provisionally to every report keeps it funded far longer than dispatching it only on confirmation of need *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-580](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-580.md) — The transition threshold is stable under error in the resource function: if an estimate of the requirement is within ε of the true one at every configuration, the estimated threshold is within ε of the true one, and an underestimate anywhere can only lower it while an overestimate can only raise it *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-585](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-585.md) — With several resources, the budgets that suffice for a transition form an upward-closed set whose minimal elements, when the transition paths are finitely many, form a Pareto frontier; the set need not be convex, so no threshold on a weighted total of the resources describes it *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-679](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-679.md) — For a fixed architecture and one resource that must be held at each moment, cutting the resource an organization holds toward what holding its present configuration requires leaves that configuration feasible and removes exactly the transitions whose threshold lies between the old holding and the new, so that at the limit the organization can still hold where it is and can reach no configuration whose transition carries any reconfiguration slack *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-922](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-922.md) — In a model with a home and a staging architecture and one capacity, the same intervention, admitting the staging architecture, creates reachability where the home configuration space is disconnected and only lowers the bottleneck budget where it is connected, while a budget or a reserve changes neither the bottleneck budget nor the least time, and a deadline shorter than every route through the staging architecture takes that remedy away *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-582](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-582.md) — Under a fixed dynamical model an added hard constraint cannot enlarge the set of admissible trajectories, so it cannot enlarge what some admissible path reaches or lower the least cost of reaching it; what it can improve is a property required of every path a disturbance or a given process may take, such as robustness or reliability, and a constraint that does more has changed the mechanism *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-593](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-593.md) — Isomorphism is not persistence, in either direction: two separately made mechanisms with the same costed transformation structure are isomorphic and still two, and one mechanism whose hinge is replaced can persist while its costed structure becomes non-isomorphic to the earlier one, so which morphisms count as continuations is structure added by assumptions about the domain, not read off the category *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-597](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-597.md) — Where every replacement part is supplied from outside, an organization can become independent of what founded it but never of what feeds it: with damage at rate d and supplied repair at rate ρs the intact fraction holds at ρs/(ρs + d), needs a supply growing as θ/(1 − θ) times the damage rate to hold a share θ, and decays as e^(−dt) once the supply stops, as DNA origami that self-heals from a strand pool and origami that replicates from supplied monomers both illustrate *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-602](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-602.md) — Where an organization's capacity is learned by doing the work it serves, and decays with disuse, outside supply that does the work first lowers the capacity kept, and the longer it does all of it the longer recovery takes once it stops, while supply that covers only what the organization cannot yet do leaves its learning untouched, so what decides dependence is the order in which supply and capacity are used, not the amount of supply *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-603](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-603.md) — A capability lost because another reliably supplies it is the Black Queen's loss, favoured to the one who loses it, and whether it is dependency or division of labour is decided by the supply, not the loss: one-way supply set from outside, as aid is, leaves a dependence that nothing in the dependent's dynamics limits and that withdrawal punishes, while reciprocal loss, each partner supplying what the other gave up, leaves interdependence, so the aim framed as self-sufficiency is better framed as reciprocity *(Proposed)*
    - [CLAIM-670](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-670.md) — An arrangement can produce the dependence through which it exploits: by reliably supplying what a party then ceases to supply for itself, it creates a reliance on the provider that the party did not have before, and the provider can use that reliance to set terms the party could earlier have refused *(Proposed)*
      - [CLAIM-747](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-747.md) — The alternatives against which a governing relationship or principle is assessed can be products of that relationship, so the present distribution of options is not a neutral baseline, and an actor cannot justify its terms by the narrowness of options it helped narrow without justification; the assessment must separate the existence of a dependence, the legitimacy of its creation, the authority exercised through it and the responsibilities of maintaining it *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-464
  - [CLAIM-605](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-605.md) — Where capacity is learned by doing, decays with disuse and needs capacity already present to grow, support that does the work has a deadline after which withdrawal no longer restores capacity, and a slow taper of such support is worse than an abrupt cut because it holds practice down long enough to cross the threshold; support that covers only what the party cannot yet do needs no taper but cannot lift a party already below the threshold *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-604
    - [CLAIM-1237](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1237.md) — Where a party's fallback is valued by what it could produce alone from a capacity learned by doing that needs capacity already present to grow, and its terms are bargained by a rule under which a more valuable fallback gets more, supply that does the party's own work lowers the terms it can obtain at any renegotiation while it never exits and no price, rule or exit changes; ending the supply restores them, asymptotically, if it ends before the capacity's deadline and not after; supply that covers only what the party cannot yet do leaves the capacity, and so the terms, as they would be with no supply; and where the party cannot exit, the fallback does not enter the terms *(Proposed)*
    - [CLAIM-673](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-673.md) — Where the capacities a collective needs to govern an arrangement are learned by exercise and lost with disuse, and the arrangement does the work through which they are exercised, the arrangement can erode the capacity to govern it, so that whether a collective can correct an arrangement is not independent of the arrangement *(Active)*
    - [CLAIM-950](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-950.md) — The competence-restriction loop is demonstrable: in capacity dynamics where competence is learned by doing and decays with disuse, making reinstatement a threshold on capacity turns a restriction justified by a lack of competence into a self-perpetuating trap, because the restriction causes the decay that holds capacity below the reinstatement threshold; the trap has a recoverability deadline, and it is escaped only by a route strong enough to restore practice or by training that adds capacity directly *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-604](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-604.md) — Where each damaged part of a structure is repaired by drawing on a flux at a rate proportional to the structure's intact share, as a flame's upkeep is, it has an ignition threshold below which it goes out with the supply still on, a supply level below which it collapses rather than declines, and an outage after which restoring the supply does not relight it; repair supplied at a rate set by the supply alone, whatever the structure's state, has none of the three *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-612](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-612.md) — Statistics conditioned on survival can be stationary and quickly reached while absorption is certain: in a finite chain whose viable states all lead to an absorbing failure, the distribution of the survivors settles on the mixing time and the survivors die out on a time longer by the ratio of the spectral gap to the hazard, so a surviving organization's stable statistics are no evidence that it persists *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-625](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-625.md) — Over time intervals, gluing and continuation are different properties of histories: under local dynamics and a pointwise viability constraint the viable histories form a sheaf, yet restriction from a longer interval to a shorter need not be onto, and a viable history on [0, t] extends viably to [0, T] exactly when its endpoint can stay viable for the remaining time, so a coherent history can be terminal *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-655](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-655.md) — The preference an optimizer reads from its remaining users can move with no one's preferences changing: the change in a weighted average splits exactly into a change in the groups' weights and a change within the groups, and when a design drives out the users it serves worst the first term alone moves the measured demand toward the design, so a metric can improve while the set of people for whom the product works shrinks *(Proposed)*
  - [CLAIM-652](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-652.md) — An organization that weighs a harmful practice by the failures its present users report can expand the practice with no act against complaint: as the harmed leave, the recognized cost of the practice falls with their share, so the score favours more of it, and the failures it records grow more slowly than the harm it does *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-697](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-697.md) — A learned system's disposition to succeed at a task is resource-conditional: the admissible ways of eliciting it are largely the affordable compositions of declared operations, so its best success probability is a nondecreasing function of the budget over nested procedure classes; repeated sampling raises a frozen model's chance that some attempt succeeds from p to 1 − (1 − p)^N with no change to its parameters; and that coverage is not delivery, which needs a selector that recognizes success, so generation, recognition and selection are separate capacities with separate costs *(Proposed)*
  - [CLAIM-1109](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1109.md) — Where a learning system samples and checks, knowledge can belong to the declared composite of generator and verifier under a sampling budget and to neither part: the generator's rare success is reach, the verifier's check is no capacity to answer, and the composite's delivered success is reliable and grounded by the check *(Proposed)*
  - [CLAIM-695](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-695.md) — Reinforcement learning on verifiable rewards can make a disposition the base model already had cheaper to realize, by moving probability toward successful trajectories the base reaches under enough sampling, which amortizes part of a search into the policy without enlarging what the base reaches at large budgets; whether a given run sharpened or expanded is an empirical question per run, settled by matched-budget coverage curves and causal tests on the tokens where the two models diverge *(Proposed)*
    - [CLAIM-699](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-699.md) — Where the reward used in RL post-training is also available as a verifier at test time, the RL model's single-sample gain is a cheaper route to what base sampling filtered by that verifier reaches at matched compute, and should not exceed it at large budgets; RL's distinctive value lies where recognition at test time is unavailable or costly, so the substitutability of training and search is fixed by the cost of recognition *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-697
- [CLAIM-702](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-702.md) — Where members' compensating effort prevents failures that an organization's conditions would otherwise produce, the prevention leaves little trace while its lapse is visible, so the organization can be credited with outcomes the compensation produced and the members blamed for failures the conditions produced: credit and blame then follow different principles *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-703](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-703.md) — One party can wrongfully bring about circumstances in which another incurs a genuine obligation, so that the second does right in discharging it and is still wronged: the manipulation changes the situation the target's sound values respond to, without deceiving it or changing its criteria, rather than working through a defect in its reasoning; the obligation so created is no larger than the circumstances support, whatever the manipulator claims *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-713](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-713.md) — A moral commitment is exploitable as a resource: because a committed party reliably acts on it, whoever controls the circumstances that trigger it can capture what its fulfilment yields and leave its costs with that party, without deception, coercion or any unreasonable choice by the party, and an institution can come to run on what it so avoids paying, with the burden falling hardest on its most conscientious members *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-708](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-708.md) — Responsibility for one's own conduct and responsibility for the conditions under which another acts are distinct and can both hold of one outcome: a party who wrongfully structures another's circumstances so that a wrong becomes likely, hard to avoid or apparently necessary can answer for that wrong while the one who commits it still answers for committing it, and the structuring is also a wrong of its own against the person structured, whether or not they comply *(Proposed)*
  - [CLAIM-707](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-707.md) — An organization can place control over the conditions of action upstream, the practical obligation to secure acceptable outcomes downstream, and blame where failure becomes visible, so that those blamed for a failure can be those with the least control over the conditions that produced it *(Proposed)*
  - [CLAIM-709](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-709.md) — Equality of wrongdoing and equality of power are separate questions: two parties can each act wrongly, even as often, while only one holds control over the terms of the other's life, so a tally of wrongful acts does not settle who is responsible for the relationship's coercive structure, and a finding of that control does not excuse the controlled party's own wrongful acts *(Proposed)* — through [ARG-113](../record/arguments.d/ARG-113.md)
  - [CLAIM-712](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-712.md) — Traceability does not settle fair attribution: a record can identify exactly which agent approved an outcome while leaving open whether that agent had the time, information, authority and alternatives that responsibility for it requires, so two arrangements with equally complete audit trails can warrant very different attributions *(Proposed)* — through [ARG-112](../record/arguments.d/ARG-112.md)
- [CLAIM-710](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-710.md) — Automation reduces procedural friction, yet procedural friction is where an opportunity to intervene in a process is exposed and perhaps what such an opportunity consists in, so removing friction can remove the points at which an unfolding decision can still be interrupted *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-711](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-711.md) — A process with no procedural friction can still be interruptible: standing constraints set slowly in advance and enforced by mechanisms faster than the process can foreclose alternatives keep it open to intervention without delaying it, so an opportunity to intervene does not consist in friction *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-723](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-723.md) — Acting before a recognized opportunity for intervention can take effect is a wrong of its own, apart from acting without consent: where a party has standing to authorize, suspend or contest an act, an actor who without adequate justification makes the act's consequences irreversible before that standing can be exercised defeats it, even where the objection would have failed *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-727](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-727.md) — Authority over a decision does not carry authority over the conditions on which it may be challenged: control of the cost, timing, evidence, forum or remedy of a challenge needs its own justification, and where an actor's authority is meant to be constrained by independently justified claims, its own judgment that it has met them cannot always establish that it has *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-737](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-737.md) — That a capability's exercise should be limited and that a given party may limit it are separate conclusions on separate grounds, neither entailing the other; the power to restrict is itself a capability, whose legitimacy turns on how it is bounded and answerable and not on whether the limit it imposes is right *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-797](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-797.md) — In a high-dimensional representation space a thin radial shell, nearly orthogonal random directions and nearly equal pairwise distances arise with no interaction at all, so they are a null baseline and not evidence of learned attraction, order or collapse; a thin annulus is not a low-dimensional manifold, and meaningful locality may be something learning has to produce *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-799](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-799.md) — Geometric separation, decodability and spectral detectability are distinct qualities of a learned representation that need not agree: a semantic direction can be decodable while related points are almost orthogonal, and a covariance spike yields a PCA outlier only above the BBP threshold √(D/N), which marks when that estimator can see the signal, not when the network acquired it *(Proposed)*
  - [CLAIM-804](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-804.md) — If learned signal strengths fall as a power law in rank, the number of directions PCA can separate from the noise bulk grows as a power of the sample-to-dimension ratio and of the signal gain, a cascade of detectability thresholds and not a self-organized critical process, and the power law then belongs to the hierarchy of signal strengths, not to the spectrum, whose bulk with a few outliers is no heavy tail *(Proposed)*
  - [CLAIM-827](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-827.md) — The occupancy threshold of a cone holding a fixed share of random directions, the BBP threshold and the alignment bifurcation are three different thresholds on one scale of alignment strength: the first at κ of order √D, the second at κ = √D·(D/N)^(1/4), the third at a coupling of order D; only the last is a transition of the system, and in the mean-field alignment model the ordering mode becomes BBP-detectable at coupling D/(1 + √(D/N)), an early warning before the bifurcation at D *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-838
- [CLAIM-800](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-800.md) — Occupancy of entailment cones is not a measure of learning: it rises when cone boundaries move as well as when representations flow, it rises under collapse, and nested cones make a coarse concept's cone entered no later than a fine one's by construction, so coarse-to-fine learning needs an independent measure of when each level's distinction becomes decodable *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-811](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-811.md) — Gradient flow into a degenerate minimum relaxes algebraically, not exponentially, and how slowly is not fixed by the learning coefficient: on the balanced line of a k-fold product loss the decay is t^(−1/(2k−2)) while the real log canonical threshold stays ½ and only its multiplicity grows to k *(Proposed)*
  - [CLAIM-843](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-843.md) — A population of independent factored modes q = ab with zero target, started small and at random, relaxes on average as a power law with a logarithmic correction, though almost every mode relaxes exponentially: each mode's rate is set by its conserved imbalance a² − b², and those rates reach down to zero with a density that does not vanish there *(Proposed)*
    - [CLAIM-844](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-844.md) — Some of the slow, power-law-like relaxation seen in training deep networks may be the algebraic relaxation of degenerate singular modes rather than critical slowing down in a collective phase, and a dependency tree of feature transitions yields power laws only if its thresholds or relaxation times are themselves broadly or self-similarly distributed *(Proposed)* — through [ARG-137](../record/arguments.d/ARG-137.md) — also rests on CLAIM-811
- [CLAIM-838](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-838.md) — On the high-dimensional unit sphere a directional bias of strength κ acts at three scales: of order one it is negligible, of order √D it shifts each cosine by order-one standard deviations and changes the occupancy of a cone holding a fixed share of random directions, and of order D it is needed for an order-one cosine or a cone of fixed angle; so discrimination can change long before visible clustering, and occupancy curves that collapse under κ/√D or κ/D are explained by geometry alone *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-860](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-860.md) — In the Lorentz model every point of an entailment cone of the widest transitive family lies farther from the origin than the cone's apex, so a scheme that keeps each item's new embedding inside the cone of its old one must raise the item's norm at every update that moves it, which drives a norm-based uncertainty down whether or not the update is correct and accounts for the norm growth such schemes report *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-869](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-869.md) — Read as sensitivity to one flipped cell, the coupling inside a Game of Life block is zero at every horizon while a single birth on its border destroys it, so the gap-isolated block test does not pick out the block, alone or in the gun; the property that keeps the block in being, its cells' tolerance of one another's loss, is what reads as no coupling *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-916](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-916.md) — A regulatory capacity's constraint set is fixed by what realizes it: K holds each constraint the capacity's own constraints depend on for their production, at the least level at which what depends on it is still produced, so once the agent and the capacity are named only the agent's boundary is left to choose *(Proposed)*
  - [CLAIM-915](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-915.md) — On the wide reading of the dependence rule, every constraint the capacity depends on belongs to K wherever it is produced, so a capacity supplied from outside is held by the agent and is precarious with its supply *(Proposed)*
